Toward the end of the eighteenth century neighbouring Santa Bárbara took over Tencoa’s administrative preeminence.

The later city of Santa Bárbara lies here.
simp_chinese:
滕科阿是洪都拉斯西部山区的一座伦卡人城镇。西班牙统治下，它成为梅塞德会传教士服务的辖区中心，修士于1554年在此建立修院。各社区之间交通困难：1791年，主教描述了崎岖山路和没有桥梁的大河。十八世纪末，邻近的圣巴巴拉取代滕科阿成为行政中心。

后来的圣巴巴拉即位于此地。

english: Tende lies in the inland hills south of the Kwanza, in a region associated with the old kingdom of Libolo and its neighbours. Libolo's rulers bore the title hango and appointed officials to govern districts in their name. By the middle of the sixteenth century the growing power of Ndongo had confined Libolo south of the Kwanza. Portuguese expeditions entered the region in the late seventeenth century, but their campaigns did not establish lasting control over it.
simp_chinese: 滕德位于宽扎河以南的内陆丘陵，所在地区与古老的利博洛王国及其邻邦有关。利博洛的统治者称为汉戈，他们任命官员代为治理各地。至十六世纪中叶，日益强大的恩东戈已将利博洛限制在宽扎河以南。十七世纪末，葡萄牙远征军进入这一地区，但其军事行动未能建立持久的控制。

english: Tendukheda lies in the Damoh country of central India, north of the Narmada valley. Monuments built by the Sengar landholders recall the family that ruled locally before later changes of sovereignty. The surrounding country stood between Bundelkhand and the territories of the Gond kings of Garha-Mandla. Strongholds such as Singorgarh and Chauragarh played an important part in the struggles between those rulers and their neighbours.
simp_chinese: 登杜凯达位于印度中部的达莫地区，在讷尔默达河谷以北。当地由森加尔地主建造的遗迹，让人想起主权更迭以前在此统治的家族。周边地区处于本德尔肯德与加尔哈—门德拉贡德国王的领土之间。辛戈尔加尔和焦拉加尔等要塞，在这些统治者与邻国的争斗中发挥了重要作用。

english: Tendžiogala lies in the countryside northeast of Raseiniai, near the wetlands of Praviršulis. Its name belonged not only to a settlement but to a district whose lands and villages can be traced in records from the late medieval period. From the fifteenth to the eighteenth century Tendžiogala served as the centre of a local district in Samogitia. Its manor is recorded from the sixteenth century and was later associated with the Bialozor family. By the end of the eighteenth century, the district formed part of the Šiauliai subdivision of Samogitia.
simp_chinese: 滕焦加拉位于拉塞尼艾东北方的乡间，靠近普拉维尔舒利斯湿地。这个名字既指聚落，也指一个地方区划；其所属土地与村庄见于中世纪晚期以来的记载。十五至十八世纪，滕焦加拉是萨莫吉蒂亚一处地方辖区的中心。当地庄园自十六世纪见于文献，后来与比亚沃佐尔家族有关。到十八世纪末，这个辖区属于萨莫吉蒂亚的希奥利艾分区。

english:
Ténenkou lies in the Macina country of the Inner Niger Delta, where the annual flood creates an environment unlike the surrounding dry Sahel. Water spreads across channels, shallow lakes, and grasslands before retreating, leaving resources that sustain fishing, rice cultivation, and cattle herding. Different communities use the same landscape at different moments of the year, making agreements over grazing, fields, and water essential to local society.

The historical Macina included several local chiefdoms along the Niger. In the early nineteenth century, Seku Amadu founded the Islamic state known as the Dina, centred on Hamdallahi. Local records credit Bori Ham Salla, a relative of Seku Amadu, with founding Ténenkou in 1818. The state's authority developed amid the delta's interdependent farming, fishing and pastoral communities.
simp_chinese:
泰南库位于尼日尔河内三角洲的马西纳地区，每年洪水创造出不同于周围干旱萨赫勒的环境。河水漫过水道、浅湖和草原，退去后留下支撑渔业、稻作与养牛业的资源。不同社群在一年中的不同时段使用同一片土地，因此围绕牧场、田地和水源达成协议，是地方社会的重要基础。

历史上的马西纳包含尼日尔河沿岸多个地方酋邦。十九世纪初，塞库·阿马杜建立以哈姆达拉伊为中心、称为迪纳的伊斯兰国家。马里地方记载称，塞库·阿马杜的亲属博里·哈姆·萨拉于1818年建立泰南库。该国权威在三角洲相互依存的农耕、渔业和牧业社群之间发展。

english: The Ténéré is a vast sandy desert east of the Aïr Mountains. Its northern reaches form an immense sheet of sand toward the low hills of the Tassili du Hoggar, while farther south the dunes of the Bilma Erg provide passages for salt caravans. Water is exceptionally scarce and rainfall may fail for years. The name comes from the Tuareg word for desert, a fitting title for this great expanse of the Sahara.
simp_chinese: 泰内雷是阿伊尔山脉以东广阔的沙漠。北部巨大的沙地一直伸向阿哈加尔塔西利的低丘，更南方的比尔马沙海则在沙丘之间为运盐商队留下通路。这里极度缺水，有时数年都不曾降雨。“泰内雷”在图阿雷格语中意为沙漠，这个名字与撒哈拉的辽阔景象十分相称。

english: Ténès is a Mediterranean port on the coast of central Algeria, backed by the hills of the Dahra. In the ninth century Andalusian merchants settled here and helped revive maritime trade. The port later linked al-Andalus with routes leading inland toward Tahert. Old Ténès preserves the mosque of Sidi Bou Maiza, a reminder of the town’s early Islamic past and its place among the ports of the central Maghreb.
simp_chinese: 提奈斯是阿尔及利亚中部地中海海岸上的港口，背靠达赫拉丘陵。九世纪，安达卢斯商人在此定居，帮助恢复海上贸易。港口后来将安达卢斯与通往内陆塔赫尔特的道路相连。老提奈斯保留着西迪布迈扎清真寺，让人想起城镇的早期伊斯兰历史及其在中马格里布港口中的地位。

english: The Tengapani flows through the country near Sadiya, on the eastern edge of the Brahmaputra valley. In the eighteenth century Tai Khamti migrants from the country east of Assam settled along its banks with the permission of the Ahom rulers. The settlement grew as others joined it, and by the end of the century Khamti chiefs had established authority at Sadiya amid the disturbances affecting the Ahom kingdom. Their settlement at Tengapani formed part of the history of migration across the eastern hills.
simp_chinese: 滕加帕尼河流经萨地亚附近，位于布拉马普特拉河谷东缘。十八世纪，来自阿萨姆以东地区的傣坎蒂移民经阿洪统治者许可，在河岸定居。随着后来者加入，聚落逐渐扩大；到世纪末，阿洪王国陷入动荡，坎蒂首领在萨地亚建立了权力。滕加帕尼的定居点是人们穿越东部山地迁徙历史的一部分。

sources.title: Reply affidavit by R-2,3,5,6,7,8,9 in OA 25 of 2023 (EZ) James Teli Camder & Tongam Jomoh Vs. Moef & CC & Ors.pdf

english: Tengchen means “great plateau” in Tibetan and lies in the mountain country of eastern Tibet. The district has long been associated with the Khyungpo tribes and with Bon religious traditions. High on Mount Zizhu stands Zizhu Monastery, one of the important Bon centres of the region, overlooking the surrounding ridges and valleys. Local tradition gives the monastery an ancient origin and credits the teacher Loden Nyingpo with reviving it in the fourteenth century. He is also remembered for restoring other Bon religious institutions in the district. Zizhu's setting and its religious heritage make it a prominent landmark in the Khyungpo highlands.
simp_chinese: 丁青藏语意为“大台地”，位于藏东山地，历史上与琼波诸部及苯教传统关系密切。孜珠寺高踞孜珠山上，俯瞰周围山岭与河谷，是这一地区重要的苯教中心之一。当地传说认为孜珠寺起源古老，并将寺院的十四世纪复兴归功于苯教大师罗丹念布。他还因恢复丁青其他苯教机构而受到纪念。高山上的寺院及其宗教传统，使孜珠成为琼波高地的重要地标。

english: Tengchong lies west of the Gaoligong Mountains, among volcanic peaks, hot springs and roads leading toward Burma. The traveler Xu Xiake crossed the mountains to reach the town in 1639 and spent more than a month exploring its surroundings. He examined the volcanic mountain of Daying, its crater and light, porous stone, and visited hot springs and sulfurous waters. His careful observations left a vivid record of a landscape shaped by fire beneath the earth.
simp_chinese: 腾冲位于高黎贡山以西，火山、温泉与通往缅甸的道路汇聚于此。1639年，旅行家徐霞客翻山来到腾冲，在此逗留一个多月，遍访周围山川。他考察打鹰山的火山口与轻而多孔的石头，也探访了温泉和硫磺水，留下对这片地下火力塑造的土地的细致记录。

english: East of Teng County the plain rises into the ridges of Lianqing Mountain. Its many peaks and valleys form a rugged setting for an old princely tomb, remembered locally as the Imperial City. The Ming burial was laid out on a southern mountain slope between flanking hills, with a stream before it. Within the tomb, painted figures in Ming dress once accompanied the dead, and an altar with a stone incense burner stood above the approach.
simp_chinese: 滕县以东，平原逐渐升入莲青山的群峰与山谷。山间有一座明代藩王陵，民间称作“皇城”。陵墓依南坡而建，两侧山岭环抱，前有溪流；墓中曾置身着明代服饰的彩绘仪仗俑，墓道上方还设有祭坛和石香炉。

english: Tenggarong lies on the Mahakam River, upstream from the old Kutai capital near the delta of eastern Borneo. Its position placed the court along the great waterway that carries the produce of the interior toward the Makassar Strait. In 1782 Sultan Aji Muhammad Muslihuddin moved the seat of Kutai Kartanegara here from Pemarangan. The new capital, initially called Tepian Pandan, became known as Tenggarong and remained the center of the sultanate.
simp_chinese: 丁加隆位于马哈坎河畔，在婆罗洲东部三角洲附近的库泰旧都上游。这里坐落在将内陆物产运往望加锡海峡的大水道上。1782年，苏丹阿吉·穆罕默德·穆斯利胡丁将库泰卡尔塔内加拉的驻地从珀马兰岸迁到此处。新都最初称特皮安潘丹，后来以丁加隆之名闻名，并继续作为苏丹国的中心。

english: The Tengger Desert covers a broad tract of the Alashan plateau west of the Helan Mountains. Its Mongolian name evokes the sky, an apt image for the vast expanse of sand beneath an open horizon. Dunes and dry basins form part of the great belt of arid land stretching across northern China and southern Mongolia, where winter cold and scarce rainfall shape the desert landscape.
simp_chinese: 腾格里沙漠覆盖贺兰山以西阿拉善高原的广大土地。它的蒙古语名称与天空有关，在开阔天际下延伸的沙海确有与天相接之感。沙丘和干旱盆地属于横跨中国北方与蒙古南部的广大旱地，严寒冬季与稀少降水共同塑造了荒漠景观。

english: Tenggulang lies in the lowlands north of the Musi River in southern Sumatra. The surrounding country is crossed by streams and patches of wet ground, with the Lalan basin farther north and the Banyuasin waterways towards the east. The wider coastal plain has a long record of human occupation: old settlement sites along the Lalan preserve traces of raised buildings, pottery and boats. Waterways remain the defining feature of the landscape between the inland forests and the coast.
simp_chinese: 滕古朗位于苏门答腊南部穆西河以北的低地。周围溪流和湿地交错，拉兰河流域在更北方，万由亚辛水道则在东面。广大沿海平原有悠久的人类居住历史：拉兰河沿岸古聚落留下高脚建筑、陶器和船只的痕迹。在内陆森林与海岸之间，水道始终是塑造地貌的重要特征。

english: Tengiz lies in a broad inland depression of the central Kazakh steppe, where salt water and reed-fringed marshes interrupt the dry plains. The Nura and Kulanotpes rivers feed the lakes of the basin, whose levels change with the seasons. The shallow waters and islands shelter immense numbers of waterbirds, including flamingos, while the surrounding grasslands stretch towards the low hills of Saryarka.
simp_chinese: 田吉兹位于中央哈萨克草原上一片广阔的内陆洼地，咸水湖与芦苇环绕的沼泽点缀着干燥平原。努拉河和库拉诺特佩斯河补给盆地中的湖泊，水位随季节变化。浅水与岛屿为大量水鸟提供栖息地，其中包括火烈鸟；周围草原则延伸至萨雷阿尔卡的低丘。

english: Lake Tengiz is a large, shallow salt lake in the central Kazakh steppe. The Nura and Kulanotpes rivers bring water to its enclosed basin, and winding channels connect it with the freshwater lakes and marshes of Korgalzhyn to the east. Its islands and saline shallows are nesting grounds for flamingos and a haven for migrating waterbirds. The lake's level fluctuates, exposing pale margins when the water retreats.
simp_chinese: 田吉兹湖是中央哈萨克草原上一座宽广而浅的咸水湖。努拉河与库拉诺特佩斯河向其内流盆地注水，蜿蜒水道将它与东面的库尔加尔金淡水湖泊和沼泽相连。岛屿与咸水浅滩是火烈鸟的筑巢地，也为迁徙水鸟提供栖息之所。湖水涨落不定，退去时会露出颜色浅淡的湖岸。

english: Tengréla lies in the savanna of the southern Manding country, along routes between the upper Niger basin and the lands to the south. Muslim merchants and scholars brought their faith and their trading connections into this region. The town is known for an earthen mosque in the Sudanese style, with projecting wooden beams and buttresses. Such buildings adapted a tradition associated with the cities of the Niger to the savanna communities farther south, where commerce and Islamic learning took root.
simp_chinese: 滕格雷拉位于南曼丁草原地区，处在尼日尔河上游流域与南方土地之间的道路上。穆斯林商人与学者将信仰和贸易联系带入这里。城镇以一座苏丹式土造清真寺闻名，建筑上伸出木梁，并有扶壁支撑。这类建筑将尼日尔河城市的传统融入更南方的草原社群，见证了商业与伊斯兰学问在当地扎根。

english: Teng County is an old town in southern Shandong, heir to the lands of the ancient state of Teng. The lofty Longquan Pagoda, an eight-sided brick and stone tower, stands beside the former temple of the same name. In 1369 the early Ming abolished Tengzhou and placed the county under Jining; it later passed to Yanzhou prefecture. The pagoda was rebuilt in 1428, its nine storeys rising above the town and its surrounding fields.
simp_chinese: 滕县是山东南部的古城，境内曾有古滕国。八角砖石结构的龙泉塔高耸于旧龙泉寺旁。明初于1369年撤销滕州，将滕县改属济宁，后又归兖州府。龙泉塔在1428年重修，九层塔身凌空而立，俯瞰城镇与周围田野。

english: Teniky is a remote site in the sandstone landscape of the Isalo massif in southern Madagascar. Its rock shelters contain rows of niches cut into the stone, together with terraces and worked walls. Charcoal from excavated structures has been dated to roughly the tenth to twelfth centuries. The workmanship has no close parallel elsewhere on Madagascar, leaving a remarkable record of people who shaped the rock of this inland valley long before the better-known kingdoms of the highlands.
simp_chinese: 泰尼基是马达加斯加南部伊萨卢山地砂岩景观中的一处偏远遗址。岩庇内有成排凿入石壁的壁龛，附近还有人工开凿的台地和石墙。发掘所得木炭的年代大约为十至十二世纪。这种石工在马达加斯加其他地方没有近似实例，留下了一群人改造内陆山谷岩壁的非凡记录；他们生活的年代远早于高地上较为人所知的诸王国。

english: Tenjin Cape projects into the northern side of Tanabe Bay on the Kii Peninsula. Wooded hills descend to broad, flat reefs, which disappear beneath the sea at high tide and emerge as the water falls. Waves have carved the layered rock into a varied shore of pools and sheltered inlets. The warm Kuroshio influences the waters here, bringing marine life from farther south.
simp_chinese: 天神崎伸入纪伊半岛田边湾的北侧。林木茂盛的丘陵向下延伸至宽阔平坦的岩礁，涨潮时礁石沉入海中，退潮时重新露出水面。波浪将层叠岩石雕成水洼和隐蔽的小湾，海岸地貌变化多端。温暖的黑潮影响此地海水，也从南方带来海洋生物。

english: Tenkasi, whose name means southern Kashi, lies near the foothills of the Western Ghats. Its great Vishwanatha temple is dedicated to Shiva and recalls the sacred city of Kashi on the Ganges. Inscriptions identify the Pandya king Parakrama Pandya as a builder of the temple. The shrine became a lasting monument of the later Pandya rulers, who retained a seat in the southern Tamil country after their power at Madurai had declined.
simp_chinese: 滕卡西意为“南方的迦尸”，位于西高止山麓附近。城中宏伟的毗湿瓦那塔神庙供奉湿婆，令人想起恒河畔的圣城迦尸。铭文记载潘迪亚国王帕拉克拉玛·潘迪亚建造了这座神庙。马杜赖的潘迪亚势力衰落后，后期潘迪亚统治者仍在泰米尔南部保有驻地，这座圣所成为他们留下的长久纪念。

english: Tenkeli lies on the river of the same name, a tributary of the Khroma in northern Yakutia. The Khroma is formed by streams descending from the Polousny Range and continues across the Yana–Indigirka lowland toward the Arctic coast. Its basin contains many lakes and wetlands, while its tributary valleys reach back into the low mountains along the southern edge of the plain.
simp_chinese: 滕凯利位于同名河流畔，这条河是雅库特北部赫罗马河的一条支流。赫罗马河由波洛乌斯内山脉流下的溪流汇合而成，穿过亚纳—因迪吉尔卡低地，流向北极海岸。流域中湖泊与湿地众多，支流河谷则伸向平原南缘的低山。

english: The Tenki rises among the eastern outliers of the Verkhoyansk Range and joins the Bytantay from the right. The larger river flows through the mountains before reaching the Yana, whose waters continue to the Laptev Sea. Forested slopes and valleys surround the Tenki's course in this cold northern interior. Winter ice gives way to a short summer season along the rivers.
simp_chinese: 坚基河发源于上扬斯克山脉东部支岭，从右岸注入贝坦泰河。贝坦泰河穿过群山后汇入亚纳河，河水继续流向拉普捷夫海。坚基河流经寒冷北方内陆的森林山坡与河谷；冬季冰封之后，河流迎来短暂的夏季。

english:
Tenkodogo is remembered as the first Mossi kingdom. Tradition tells of the princess Yennenga, who fled her father Naa Gbewaa and married the Mande elephant hunter Rialé. Their son Ouédraogo received four horses and fifty cows from his grandfather at Gambaga, gathered horsemen, and conquered the local people. He founded Tenkodogo and married Pouiriketa, who bore him three sons. The eldest, Diaba Lompo, founded Fada N'gourma, and the second, Rawa, ruled Zondoma, while the third, Zoungrana, succeeded his father at Tenkodogo.

Zoungrana's son Oubri, who ruled about 1050 to 1090, is regarded as the founder of the Ouagadougou dynasty, and after him the kings of Ouagadougou were the leading line among the Mossi. Tenkodogo kept its own independent ruler. Oral tradition places Yennenga anywhere between the eleventh and the fifteenth centuries, but the Mossi kingdoms themselves took shape only between the fifteenth and sixteenth.
simp_chinese:
滕科多戈被视为第一个莫西王国。传说公主延嫩加逃离父亲纳·格瓦巴，嫁给曼德族象猎人里亚莱。他们的儿子韦德拉奥果在甘巴加从外祖父那里得到四匹马和五十头牛，招募骑手，征服了当地人。他建立了滕科多戈，娶了普伊里凯塔，生下三个儿子：长子迪亚巴·隆波建立了法达恩古尔马，次子拉瓦统治宗多马，三子宗格拉纳在滕科多戈继承父位。

宗格拉纳之子乌布里（约1050至1090年在位）被视为瓦加杜古王朝的创建者，此后瓦加杜古的国王成为莫西诸王中的主要一支，而滕科多戈仍保有自己独立的统治者。口述传统把延嫩加放在11至15世纪之间，而莫西诸王国本身要到15至16世纪之间才成形。

english:
The Taensa, or Tensas, lived in villages beside Lake St. Joseph, an old channel of the Mississippi in northeastern Louisiana. Their communities occupied a country of river bends, wooded bottomlands and fertile alluvial soil. French visitors in the late seventeenth century described the Taensa village and its leaders, noting a society linked to the neighbouring Natchez people.

Henri de Tonti visited the lake during La Salle’s expedition in 1682. In 1706 the Taensa left their homes under the threat of raids connected with the trade in enslaved Indigenous people. They moved south and later sought French protection near Mobile Bay. The Tensas River and the surrounding country retain their name, recalling a people whose villages once stood beside the Mississippi’s old waters.
simp_chinese:
滕萨斯人曾住在路易斯安那东北部圣约瑟夫湖畔的村庄中。这片湖泊是密西西比河的旧河道，周围有河湾、林木低地和肥沃冲积土。十七世纪末到访的法国人描述了滕萨斯村庄及其领袖，也记下了他们与邻近纳奇兹人的联系。

1682年，亨利·德·通蒂随拉萨尔远征时到过湖畔。1706年，滕萨斯人因与原住民奴隶贸易有关的袭击威胁而离开家园。他们向南迁移，后来在莫比尔湾附近寻求法国保护。滕萨斯河和周边地区保留了他们的名字，令人想起曾经矗立在密西西比河旧水道旁的村庄。

english: Tenteksor is a group of salt flats in the dry lowlands of the Sagiz. The river loses itself among these shallow depressions before reaching the Emba, and its water becomes strongly mineralised after the spring floods. Salt-loving shrubs grow on the flats, while seasonal pools interrupt the arid plain. The valley formed part of the country crossed by routes between the lower Ural and the interior of Central Asia.
simp_chinese: 坚特克索尔是萨吉兹河干旱低地上的一组盐碱滩。河流在抵达恩巴河之前消失在浅洼地中，春季洪水过后，河水的矿物质含量显著升高。耐盐灌木生长在盐滩上，季节性水池点缀干旱平原。这里属于下乌拉尔与中亚内陆之间道路经过的地区。

english: Tenut lies in the Oymyakon country of the upper Indigirka, among the Yana-Oymyakon Highlands. The Indigirka flows north from these mountains to the East Siberian Sea. Its upper valley is known for severe winters, when the surrounding valleys trap the cold air.
simp_chinese: 捷努特位于因迪吉尔卡河上游的奥伊米亚康一带，四周是亚纳—奥伊米亚康高地。因迪吉尔卡河从群山中向北流往东西伯利亚海；上游河谷冬季严寒，周围山谷容易积聚冷空气。

english: Teočak is a fortified site in the hills of northeastern Bosnia, near the western approaches to the Drina. It appears in fifteenth-century records in connection with the Serbian despot Đurađ Branković, who held territory in this contested borderland. Later, Nicholas of Ilok held Teočak as count while exercising authority in Usora. The castle eventually passed to the Ottomans and appears in a sixteenth-century register of the Sanjak of Zvornik.
simp_chinese: 泰奥恰克是波斯尼亚东北部丘陵中的设防据点，靠近德里纳河以西的通道。十五世纪文献将它与塞尔维亚专制公久拉杰·布兰科维奇联系起来，他曾在这片争夺不休的边疆拥有领地。后来，伊洛克的米克洛什以伯爵身份掌握泰奥恰克，并在乌索拉行使权力。城堡最终落入奥斯曼人之手，见于十六世纪兹沃尔尼克桑贾克的登记册。

english: Teoo is an islet on the northern rim of Tikehau, a coral atoll west of Rangiroa. Archaeological remains attest to earlier Polynesian occupation of the atoll. In 1816 Otto von Kotzebue identified Tikehau during his Pacific voyage and named it Krusenstern.
simp_chinese: 特奥奥是蒂凯豪环礁北缘的一座小岛，位于朗伊罗阿以西。考古遗迹证明波利尼西亚人曾在环礁上居住。1816年，奥托·冯·科策布在太平洋航行时辨认出蒂凯豪，将其命名为克鲁森施特恩。

english:
Teotenango occupies the summit of Tetépetl, a lava ridge overlooking the southern Valley of Toluca. Terraces, walls and ceremonial buildings cover the hill, reflecting a long sequence of occupation. The Matlatzinca made it an important centre, and its elevated position provided a commanding view across the broad valley far below.

The site was occupied long before the fifteenth century, but the growing Mexica state extended its power into Matlatzinco in the later 1400s. Mexica occupation followed at Teotenango, whose inhabitants had built and rebuilt on the hill for many generations. After the Spanish conquest the settlement on the heights declined as colonial communities developed below. Its surviving stonework preserves the layered history of the peoples who held this strategic hilltop.
simp_chinese:
特奥特南戈占据特特佩特尔山顶，这条熔岩山脊俯瞰托卢卡谷地南部。梯田、墙垣和仪式建筑覆盖山丘，反映出漫长的居住历史。马特拉钦卡人将这里发展为重要中心，高处的位置使人得以俯视下方谷地。

这处遗址在十五世纪之前很久便已有人居住；十五世纪后期，日益强大的墨西加政权将势力伸入马特拉钦科。墨西加人随后占据特奥特南戈，而当地居民此前已在山上世代建造和重建。西班牙征服后，随着山下殖民聚落发展，高处的聚落逐渐衰落。留存的石建筑保存了不同族群占据这一战略高地的层叠历史。

english: Cerro Teotepec rises in the Sierra Madre del Sur above the Pacific coast of southern Mexico. Its Nahuatl name means “Hill of the God”, and its summit is the highest in Guerrero. The mountain stands among the ridges that separate the coastal plain from the interior valleys. Streams descend from this rugged high country toward the coast, crossing steep slopes before reaching the warmer lowlands.
simp_chinese: 特奥特佩克山耸立在墨西哥南部太平洋海岸后方的南马德雷山脉中。它的纳瓦特尔语名称意为“神之山”，山顶是格雷罗的最高点。这座山属于分隔海岸平原与内陆谷地的山岭；溪流从崎岖高地下泄，穿越陡坡，流向温暖的沿海低地。

english: Teotitlan del Camino lies in the Cañada, the corridor between the highlands of Oaxaca and the valley of Tehuacán. Its position on the road linking Oaxaca to Puebla and Mexico City gave the settlement its distinctive name, “Teotitlan of the Road.” The surrounding country formed part of a region where colonial encomiendas included Teotitlan, Cuicatlán, Tecomavaca and other indigenous towns.
simp_chinese: 特奥蒂特兰德尔卡米诺位于卡尼亚达地区，这条通道连接瓦哈卡高地与特瓦坎谷地。它坐落在通往普埃布拉和墨西哥城的道路上，因而得名“道路上的特奥蒂特兰”。殖民时期，特奥蒂特兰、奎卡特兰、特科马瓦卡等原住民城镇被纳入当地的监护征赋制度。

english: Teozacualco was a Mixtec lordship in the highlands of Oaxaca. Its ruling family claimed a history linked to the dynasty of Tilantongo, brought under its authority through marriage. In 1580 the community produced a painted map showing its territory and rulers for the Spanish colonial government. Indigenous place signs and genealogies appear alongside churches and European conventions, preserving an account of political identity across the conquest.
simp_chinese: 特奥萨夸尔科是瓦哈卡高地的米斯特克领地。统治家族的历史与蒂兰通戈王朝相连，后者通过王朝婚姻归入其势力。1580年，社群为西班牙殖民政府绘制地图，展示领地与统治者。原住民地名符号和谱系与教堂、欧洲绘图方式并列，保存了跨越征服时期的政治身份记述。

english:
Tecpatitlan, later known as Tepatitlán, was a Tecuexe settlement in the highlands of Los Altos. It stood among indigenous communities north of Guadalajara, with a local ruler named Mapelo remembered in accounts of the Spanish arrival. The surrounding countryside later acquired Spanish ranches and estates while the town remained an indigenous community. Its early churches dedicated to Saint Francis were modest adobe chapels with roofs of thatch and tile.

In 1530 Pedro Almíndez Chirinos reached Tecpatitlan during the expedition of Nuño de Guzmán. Local tradition records that Mapelo received him and guided him toward Zacatec country. During the Mexican War of Independence, insurgents under the priest Ramos took the town after a battle in 1811. Tepatitlán received the title of villa in 1824, after independence.
simp_chinese:
特克帕蒂特兰后来称为特帕蒂特兰，是洛斯阿尔托斯高地的一处特奎克塞人聚落。它坐落在瓜达拉哈拉以北的原住民社区之间，关于西班牙人到来的记载中提到了当地领主马佩洛。周边乡间后来出现西班牙人的牧场与庄园，城镇则仍为原住民社区。早期供奉圣方济各的教堂是简朴的土坯礼拜堂，屋顶覆盖茅草和瓦片。

1530年，佩德罗·阿尔明德斯·奇里诺斯随努尼奥·德·古斯曼的远征抵达特克帕蒂特兰。地方传统记载，马佩洛接待了他，并带他前往萨卡特克人的土地。墨西哥独立战争期间，神父拉莫斯率领的起义军于1811年经过战斗攻占此镇。独立后，特帕蒂特兰于1824年获授城镇地位。

english: The Tepecano inhabited the mountain country of northern Jalisco and neighboring southern Zacatecas. Their communities lived among the valleys and canyons of the Bolaños River, close to the lands of the Huichol. One of their settlements, Azqueltán, stood deep in the river canyon. Around 1589 or 1590 the Franciscan Juan Gómez founded villages in the region, including Azqueltán and Totatiche. The Tepecano maintained their own language, related to those of the Tepehuan peoples farther north.
simp_chinese: 特佩卡诺人生活在哈利斯科北部及萨卡特卡斯南部相邻的山地。他们的社群分布于博拉尼奥斯河谷和峡谷之间，靠近维乔尔人的土地。其聚落之一阿斯克尔坦坐落在深邃的河谷中。约1589或1590年，方济各会士胡安·戈麦斯在此地区建立村庄，包括阿斯克尔坦和托塔蒂切。特佩卡诺人保持自己的语言，与更北方特佩万诸民族的语言相关。

english: Tepecoacuilco lies in northern Guerrero, in the warm Balsas basin of southern Mexico. Before Spanish rule it gave its name to a province that paid tribute to the Mexica empire, and the tribute lists in the Codex Mendoza record the cloth, cacao, feathers and other goods its towns sent to Tenochtitlan. Its lords ruled the surrounding valleys from the town, which stood on a hill above the river. After the conquest of Tenochtitlan in 1521, Spanish officials took over the tribute, and Tepecoacuilco became a town of colonial administration.
simp_chinese: 特佩科阿奎尔科位于格雷罗北部，处在墨西哥南部温暖的巴尔萨斯盆地。西班牙统治之前，它是一处向墨西卡帝国纳贡的省名，《门多萨抄本》中的贡赋册记录了其城镇送往特诺奇提特兰的布匹、可可和羽毛等货物。领主从坐落在河上山丘的城镇统治周围河谷。1521年特诺奇提特兰陷落后，西班牙官员接管了贡赋，特佩科阿奎尔科随之成为殖民行政的城镇。

english:
The Tepehuan inhabited the mountains and valleys of northern Durango, where their communities cultivated crops and moved among settlements in the Sierra Madre. Their name comes from Nahuatl and refers to people of the mountains. Spanish mines and Jesuit missions reached their country in the sixteenth century, bringing new demands and drawing communities into settlements such as Santiago Papasquiaro, Santa Catarina and El Zape.

In November 1616 Tepehuan leaders launched a widespread uprising against Spanish rule. Missions and settlements were attacked across the region, including Santiago Papasquiaro and El Zape. Spanish forces fought the rebels over the following years, and the revolt was declared ended in 1620. Many surviving Tepehuan withdrew into the mountains, while missionaries spent years attempting to draw them back to mission communities. The upheaval left a lasting mark on the northern frontier of Nueva Vizcaya.
simp_chinese:
特佩万人生活在杜兰戈北部的山脉与谷地，在马德雷山脉各聚落之间活动并种植作物。他们的名称源自纳瓦特尔语，与山地有关。十六世纪，西班牙矿区和耶稣会传教站进入他们的土地，带来新的要求，也将社群聚集到圣地亚哥帕帕斯基亚罗、圣卡塔里纳和埃尔萨佩等聚落。

1616年11月，特佩万首领发动大规模起义，反抗西班牙统治。各地传教站和聚落遭到袭击，包括圣地亚哥帕帕斯基亚罗与埃尔萨佩。此后数年西班牙军队与起义者交战，1620年起义被宣布结束。许多幸存的特佩万人退入山地，传教士又花费多年试图将他们带回传教社群。这场动乱在新比斯开北部边疆留下长久影响。

english: Tepeticpac was one of the four principal lordships of Tlaxcallan, set on high ground in the central Mexican highlands. Its defensible position gave it a military role within the confederation, alongside the centres of Ocotelolco, Tizatlan and Quiahuiztlan. In 1519 its lord Tlahuexolotzin joined the other rulers in deliberations over the Spaniards. Tlaxcalan warriors subsequently became crucial allies in the campaigns against Tenochtitlan.
simp_chinese: 特佩蒂克帕克是特拉斯卡兰四个主要领地之一，坐落在墨西哥中部高地的高处。易守的位置使它在联盟中承担军事作用，与奥科特洛尔科、蒂萨特兰和基亚维斯特兰并列。1519年，领主特拉韦绍洛钦与其他统治者共同商议如何对待西班牙人。此后，特拉斯卡拉武士成为进攻特诺奇蒂特兰的关键盟军。

english:
Tepexi was the centre of an important independent Popoloca lordship in the dry country south of Puebla. Its old fortified settlement occupied a plateau protected by two deep ravines, with walls enclosing plazas and ceremonial mounds. The Nahuatl name means “split rock”, a fitting description of the steep landscape around the town.

Tepexi el Viejo was occupied from about 1300 until the Spanish conquest. Its defences guarded a community that faced the growing power of the Mexica in the fifteenth century. After the conquest, Spanish authorities ordered settlements moved to lower and more accessible places; the later town of Tepexi developed away from the fortified heights. In colonial times the district became known for silk, produced from mulberry trees and silkworms.
simp_chinese:
特佩希是普埃布拉以南干旱地区一个重要波波洛卡领地的中心。旧城建在被深峡谷保护的高地上，城墙围绕广场与仪式土丘。其纳瓦特尔语名称意为“裂开的岩石”，恰如周围陡峭的地貌。

特佩希旧城约从1300年持续有人居住至西班牙征服时期。十五世纪，防御工事保护着面临墨西加势力扩张的社群。征服后，西班牙当局下令将聚落迁往更低、更易抵达的地点；后来的特佩希镇因此远离设防的高地。殖民时期，这一地区以种桑养蚕、生产丝绸闻名。

english:
Tepeyacac, later called Tepeaca, lies on the road between the Valley of Mexico and the Gulf coast. It was a major Indigenous centre in the Puebla region, and its position made it valuable to powers seeking to control the routes across the highlands. The Mexica brought it under their rule in the fifteenth century.

In 1520, after withdrawing from Tenochtitlan, Hernán Cortés established a Spanish town in the province and named it Segura de la Frontera. From there he wrote to the Spanish king about the campaign and ordered a fort constructed. The town became a base for operations against neighbouring communities. Franciscan friars established a convent at Tepeyacac in 1529, making it an early centre of missionary activity among the peoples of the region.
simp_chinese:
特佩亚卡克后来称为特佩阿卡，位于墨西哥谷地与墨西哥湾沿岸之间的道路上。它是普埃布拉地区重要的原住民中心，地处高地交通要道，对寻求控制这些路线的势力十分重要。墨西加人于十五世纪将其纳入统治。

1520年，埃尔南·科尔特斯从特诺奇蒂特兰撤退后，在这一省建立西班牙人城镇，命名为塞古拉德拉弗龙特拉。他从这里致信西班牙国王，报告战事，并下令修建堡垒。城镇成为对邻近社群展开行动的基地。1529年，方济各会修士在特佩亚卡克建立修道院，使其成为向本地区各族传教的早期中心。

english: Tepeyahualco lies on the high, dry plains east of Puebla, near the ancient city of Cantona. Built on volcanic ground, Cantona possessed walled streets, plazas, ballcourts and workshops where obsidian was worked. Its position helped it control a route between the central highlands and the Gulf coast. The nearby Oyameles–Zaragoza deposits supplied obsidian that circulated widely through Mesoamerica during the city’s long occupation.
simp_chinese: 特佩亚瓦尔科位于普埃布拉以东干燥的高原上，靠近古城坎托纳。坎托纳建在火山地面上，拥有围墙街道、广场、球场和黑曜石工坊。其位置有助于控制中部高地与墨西哥湾岸之间的道路。附近的奥亚梅莱斯—萨拉戈萨矿床提供黑曜石，在这座城市漫长的存续期间广泛流通于美索美洲。

english: Teplá lies on the river of the same name in the western Bohemian uplands. Its Premonstratensian abbey was founded in 1193 by the nobleman Hroznata of Ovenec, and its first monks came from Strahov in Prague. The neighbouring town, recorded in 1197, guarded a land entrance with a market and customs post. Abbot Raimund Wilfert II rebuilt the monastery around the turn of the eighteenth century; the older church retained its Romanesque and early Gothic forms, with a new high altar added in 1750.
simp_chinese: 泰普拉位于波希米亚西部高地的同名河畔。1193年，贵族赫罗兹纳塔·冯·奥韦内茨创建普雷蒙特雷会修道院，首批修士来自布拉格的斯特拉霍夫修道院。邻近城镇最早见于1197年的记载，守护着设有集市和关卡的陆路入口。十八世纪前后，院长赖蒙德·维尔费特二世重建修道院；较早的教堂保留了罗马式和早期哥特式形制，1750年又增添新的主祭坛。

english: Teply Klyuch lies on the Eastern Khandyga, east of the Aldan valley in the foothills of the Verkhoyansk mountains. The river descends from the mountains toward the Tompo and the Aldan, linking the highland streams with the Lena basin. This is a land of sharply continental weather, with a long, intensely cold winter and a brief summer along the wooded valleys.
simp_chinese: 捷普雷克柳奇位于阿尔丹河谷以东、上扬斯克山麓的东汉德加河畔。河水从山地流向通波河和阿尔丹河，将高地溪流与勒拿河流域相连。此地大陆性气候鲜明，冬季漫长而严寒，森林覆盖的河谷中夏季则十分短暂。

english: Teplyk lies in eastern Podolia on a tributary of the Southern Bug. A fortified settlement existed here by the fifteenth century, on land exposed to attacks from the steppe. In 1582 it came into the possession of the Ostrogski family. The town grew around its defences, with craftsmen and traders serving the surrounding countryside; its history followed the turbulent fortunes of the Bratslav frontier.
simp_chinese: 泰普利克位于波多利亚东部、南布格河的一条支流畔。这里最迟在十五世纪已有设防的居民点，所处地域容易受到草原袭击。1582年，城镇归奥斯特罗格斯基家族所有。它围绕防御工事发展，工匠和商人为周围乡村提供服务，其历史也随着布拉茨拉夫边境的动荡而起伏。

english: The rugged valleys of the Diablo Range lie east of the Salinas Valley in central California. Chalon communities lived among these hills and streams, including the country around San Benito Mountain. In 1791 Spanish missionaries founded Mission Soledad to the west. Many Chalon people were baptized and drawn into mission life, where introduced diseases and severe disruption of their ways of life caused heavy loss.
simp_chinese: 迪亚布洛山脉崎岖的山谷位于加利福尼亚中部萨利纳斯河谷以东。查隆人社群生活在这些山岭与溪流之间，包括圣贝尼托山周围地区。1791年，西班牙传教士在西面建立索莱达德传教所。许多查隆人受洗并进入传教所生活，外来疾病以及原有生活方式受到的严重破坏造成了沉重损失。

english: The mountains north of Tlaxcala form part of the rugged transition between the central Mexican plateau and the Sierra Norte. High ridges and enclosed valleys separate the settlements of the plateau from the humid country descending toward the Gulf. Nahua communities lived among these hills before the Spanish conquest, while the lordships of Tlaxcallan held the highland basin to the south against the expansion of the Mexica.
simp_chinese: 特拉斯卡拉以北的山地属于墨西哥中部高原与北部山脉之间崎岖的过渡地带。高耸山岭与封闭谷地将高原聚落和通向墨西哥湾的湿润地区隔开。西班牙征服前，纳瓦社群居住在这些丘陵之间；南方高地盆地中的特拉斯卡兰诸领地则抵抗着墨西加人的扩张。

english:
Teqali lies in the highlands of the northeastern Nuba Mountains, a cluster of rugged hills above the plains of Kordofan. The massif was the heart of a kingdom whose rulers bore the title of mek. Its strongholds and settlements occupied a landscape of steep slopes and valleys, distinct from the open country surrounding the mountains.

Tradition places the rise of the kingdom in the late sixteenth century, although its early chronology is debated. It appears in written accounts during the reign of Badi II of Sennar, who sent an expedition against its ruler in the seventeenth century. Teqali endured amid the rivalries of Sennar and Darfur, maintaining a political centre in the hills while its relations with the lowland powers changed.
simp_chinese:
特卡利位于努巴山脉东北部的高地，崎岖山丘俯瞰着科尔多凡平原。这片山地曾是一个王国的中心，其统治者称为梅克。要塞和聚落分布在陡坡与山谷之间，景观不同于群山周围的开阔平原。

按照传统，王国兴起于十六世纪末，但其早期年代仍有争议。森纳尔苏丹巴迪二世在位时，曾于十七世纪派兵征讨这里的统治者，特卡利也由此出现在文字记载中。在森纳尔与达尔富尔的角逐中，特卡利保有山中的政治中心，同时与低地强权的关系不断变化。

sources.title: Taylor Bieniada SN 2007 Archaeological reconnaissance in the Nuba mountains.pdf

english: Tequemapo was one of the towns of southern Florida named by Hernando de Escalante Fontaneda, a Spaniard who lived for years among the region's Native peoples after a shipwreck. He listed it with coastal settlements under the authority of Carlos, the Calusa chief. The Calusa homeland encompassed the estuaries and shores of the southwest, where fishing sustained a society whose chiefs maintained far-reaching political and trading networks.
simp_chinese: 特奎马波是埃尔南多·德埃斯卡兰特·丰塔内达记下的佛罗里达南部村镇之一。这位西班牙人遭遇海难后，曾在当地原住民中生活多年；他将特奎马波列为卡卢萨酋长卡洛斯统辖的沿海聚落之一。卡卢萨人的故土包括西南方的河口与海岸，捕鱼维系着这里的社会，而酋长掌握着延伸甚远的政治和贸易网络。

english:
At the mouth of the Miami River, where fresh water enters Biscayne Bay, stood the principal village of the Tequesta people. Their territory extended along the southeastern coast of Florida, among mangrove shores, islands and wetlands. Fish, shellfish and other animals of the coastal waters formed an important part of their diet, while canoes carried them between settlements along the shore.

In 1567 Pedro Menéndez de Avilés established a Spanish post and Jesuit mission near the Tequesta village. Relations soon deteriorated, and the mission was abandoned. Spanish missionaries returned briefly in 1743, founding Santa María de Loreto by the river, but left within months. In 1763, when Spain ceded Florida to Britain, surviving Native people from southern Florida went to Cuba with the departing Spanish.
simp_chinese:
迈阿密河注入比斯坎湾，特奎斯塔人的主要村落便坐落在河口。他们的领地沿佛罗里达东南海岸延伸，分布着红树林海岸、岛屿和湿地。鱼、贝类及其他近海动物是重要的食物来源，独木舟则载着人们往来于沿岸聚落之间。

1567年，佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯在特奎斯塔村附近建立西班牙据点和耶稣会传教站。双方关系很快恶化，传教站最终被放弃。1743年，西班牙传教士短暂返回，在河边建立洛雷托圣玛丽亚传教站，数月后便离开。1763年西班牙将佛罗里达割让给英国时，佛罗里达南部幸存的原住民随撤离的西班牙人前往古巴。

english: Téra lies in Liptako west of the Niger, near the Dargol, a seasonal tributary of the great river. Its name comes from the Gourmanché language and means frog. Songhai-Zarma, Gourmantché, Fulbe and Tuareg communities inhabit the wider country, where farming and herding share the dry Sahelian landscape. The Dargol flows during the rains towards the Niger, while pools and pasture support life through the changing seasons.
simp_chinese: 泰拉位于尼日尔河以西的利普塔科，靠近大河季节性支流达尔戈尔河。城名来自古尔曼切语，意为“青蛙”。桑海－扎尔马、古尔曼切、富尔贝和图阿雷格社群居住在广大地区，耕作与畜牧共同利用干燥的萨赫勒土地。达尔戈尔河在雨季流向尼日尔河，水塘和牧场则随季节变化支撑当地生活。

english: Teraina is a low coral island in the northern Line Islands, unusual for its freshwater lake surrounded by wetlands. Archaeological remains indicate earlier Polynesian occupation. In 1798 Edmund Fanning visited the island during a Pacific voyage and named it Washington Island, a name used by later mariners.
simp_chinese: 泰拉伊纳是莱恩群岛北部的低矮珊瑚岛，岛上一片被湿地环绕的淡水湖颇为特别。考古遗迹显示波利尼西亚人曾在此居住。1798年，埃德蒙·范宁在太平洋航行中到访此岛，将它命名为华盛顿岛；后来的航海者沿用了这一名称。

english: Teraina is a low coral island in the northern Line Islands, surrounded by the waters of the central Pacific. Unlike many atolls, it contains a freshwater lake. The American captain Edmund Fanning sighted it in 1798 and named it Washington Island, but did not attempt to land.
simp_chinese: 泰拉伊纳是莱恩群岛北部的一座低平珊瑚岛，周围是中太平洋的海水。与许多环礁不同，岛上有一座淡水湖。1798年，美国船长埃德蒙·范宁望见此岛，将它命名为华盛顿岛，但没有尝试登陆。

english:
Teramo lies between the Apennines and the Adriatic, at the meeting of the Tordino and Vezzola rivers. Its cathedral, dedicated to the Assumption and to Saint Berardo, preserves the work of craftsmen who adorned the church across several centuries. Among its treasures is a silver altar frontal made by Nicola da Guardiagrele.

The frontal was commissioned by Bishop Giosia d’Acquaviva and made between 1433 and 1448. Its many small reliefs portray episodes from the life of Christ around a central image of the Redeemer. In the same century, rivalry between the Melatino and Della Valle families brought violent factional struggles to Teramo. Centuries later, the town was briefly occupied by French forces in 1798, amid the upheaval that reached the Kingdom of Naples.
simp_chinese:
泰拉莫位于亚平宁山脉与亚得里亚海之间，坐落在托尔迪诺河与韦佐拉河的交汇处。当地的主教座堂献给圣母升天与圣贝拉尔多，保存着历代工匠装饰教堂的作品，其中包括尼科拉·达瓜尔迪亚格雷莱制作的银质祭坛正面饰板。

这件饰板由主教乔西亚·达夸维瓦委托制作，完成于1433年至1448年。中央的救世主像四周排列着许多小幅浮雕，描绘基督生平。同一世纪，梅拉蒂诺家族与德拉瓦莱家族的争斗也给泰拉莫带来了暴力派系冲突。几个世纪后，那不勒斯王国卷入动荡，法国军队于1798年短暂占领了这座城市。

english: The Teribe, also known as Naso or Térraba, are an Indigenous people of the forests and river valleys of Talamanca and western Panama. Their language belongs to the Chibchan family. Late in the seventeenth century Spanish missionaries moved some Teribe from the Caribbean side of the mountains to the Pacific slope, where San Francisco de Térraba was established. Other communities remained in the northern river country, preserving connections across the mountain region.
simp_chinese: 特里韦人又称纳索人或特拉巴人，是塔拉曼卡及巴拿马西部森林与河谷中的原住民族。他们的语言属于奇布查语系。十七世纪末，西班牙传教士将部分特里韦人从山脉的加勒比海一侧迁至太平洋坡地，在那里建立圣弗朗西斯科·德·特拉巴。其他社区仍留在北方河流地区，维系着山地两侧的联系。

english: The Terbuny country lies south of Yelets, on the forest-steppe between the upper Don and the Oskol basin. To the east stood the older village of Terbuny, established by service people from the Smolensk country and recorded in the seventeenth century. Its name has been connected with the working of flax, an occupation associated with those settlers. The district formed part of the lands settled as the Russian frontier moved southward; the later settlement that inherited the Terbuny name arose only after this period.
simp_chinese: 捷尔布内一带位于叶列茨以南，处在顿河上游与奥斯科尔河流域之间的森林草原。东面有较早的捷尔布内村，由来自斯摩棱斯克地区的服役人员建立，见于十七世纪记载。村名被认为与这些定居者从事的亚麻加工有关。随着俄罗斯边疆南移，这一地区逐渐得到定居；后来沿用捷尔布内名称的聚落则出现于此时代之后。

english: Tylgynii lies in the lake-strewn country of the Central Yakutian Lowland, north of the Vilyuy. The place also bears the name Terbyas, and belongs to a landscape of forests, marshes and lakes in the great river's basin. A sharply continental climate brings a long, cold winter and a summer that passes quickly before the return of frost.
simp_chinese: 特尔格尼位于维柳伊河以北、中雅库特低地的湖泊地带。此地也称捷尔比亚斯，周围是这条大河流域中的森林、沼泽与湖泊。强烈的大陆性气候带来漫长寒冷的冬季，短暂的夏季转瞬即逝，霜冻便再度降临。

english: Tercan lies beside the Tuzla, a tributary of the Euphrates, on the road between Erzurum and Erzincan. Its most striking monument is the tomb traditionally associated with Mama Hatun, a woman who ruled the Saltukid principality around the end of the twelfth century. A circular stone enclosure surrounds the tower-like tomb, whose architect came from Ahlat. A caravanserai and bath nearby recall the travellers who followed the road across the highlands.
simp_chinese: 泰尔詹位于幼发拉底河支流图兹拉河畔，坐落在埃尔祖鲁姆与埃尔津詹之间的道路上。最引人注目的建筑是传统上归于玛玛·哈敦的陵墓；她是一位约在十二世纪末统治萨尔图克公国的女性。圆形石墙环绕着塔形墓室，建筑师来自阿赫拉特。附近的商队旅舍和浴室令人想起沿高原道路往来的旅人。

english: The island of Terceira lies among the central Azores, with the harbor of Angra on its southern coast. From the fifteenth century, Angra became a port of call for vessels crossing the Atlantic and for fleets returning from Africa, Asia and the Americas. The island also produced grain and woad, a dye plant exported from the archipelago. Its anchorage placed Terceira at a meeting point of long ocean routes.
simp_chinese: 特塞拉岛位于亚速尔群岛中部，南岸有安格拉港。自十五世纪起，安格拉成为横渡大西洋船只的停靠港，也接待从非洲、亚洲和美洲返航的舰队。岛上生产谷物和菘蓝，后者是群岛出口的染料植物。其锚地使特塞拉成为漫长远洋航线的交汇点。

english:
Tere is a stone-walled settlement among granite hills in the eastern country of the Zimbabwe plateau. Its masonry belongs to the wider tradition of stone building that flourished at Great Zimbabwe. Local Budya people call it Tere raMakate, the former village of Makate. Their tradition tells of his powerful charms and his defeat by Nehoreka, whose sister married Makate and secretly took away the source of his power.

Finds from the site suggest that it flourished around the fourteenth century, in the same broad period as Great Zimbabwe. Gold and imported ceramics found among its remains connect Tere with the craftsmen and exchange networks of the plateau, while its stone walls recall the authority of the people who made their homes on the hill.
simp_chinese:
泰雷是津巴布韦高原东部花岗岩丘陵间的一处石墙聚落，其砌石属于在大津巴布韦兴盛的广大建筑传统。当地布贾人称它为“泰雷拉马卡特”，即马卡特的旧村。传说马卡特拥有强大的法术，后来尼霍雷卡的妹妹嫁给他，秘密取走他力量的来源，尼霍雷卡便将其击败。

遗址出土物显示，泰雷约在14世纪兴盛，与大津巴布韦大体同时。黄金和输入陶瓷将它与高原的工匠及交换网络联系起来，石墙则令人想起曾在山上居住的统治者的权威。

english:
Terebovlia was a princely centre of Rus', first mentioned in the chronicle of 1097. Its lands stretched across southeastern Galicia towards Podolia and Bukovina. In later centuries the castle above the town formed part of the Polish frontier's defences against attacks from the south and east.

Rebuilt in the fourteenth century, the fortress guarded a town repeatedly struck by Tatars. Bernard Pretwicz, a notable commander against Tatar raids, held the office of starosta here in the sixteenth century. Severyn Nalyvaiko's Cossacks plundered the town in 1594. During the Ottoman war of 1675, attackers destroyed Terebovlia but a small Polish garrison and townspeople held the castle until King John III Sobieski came to their relief. The fortress was destroyed during another Ottoman invasion in 1688.
simp_chinese:
捷列博夫利亚曾是罗斯诸侯的中心，首见于1097年的编年史。其领地横跨加利西亚东南部，伸向波多利亚和布科维纳。后来，城镇上方的城堡成为波兰边境防御体系的一部分，抵御来自南方和东方的进攻。

这座十四世纪重建的要塞守卫着一座屡遭鞑靼袭击的城镇。十六世纪，以抗击鞑靼劫掠闻名的指挥官贝尔纳德·普雷特维奇在此担任地方长官。1594年，谢韦林·纳利瓦伊科的哥萨克劫掠城镇。1675年奥斯曼战争期间，进攻者摧毁捷列博夫利亚，但少数波兰守军和市民坚守城堡，直到扬三世·索别斯基国王赶来解围。1688年另一次奥斯曼入侵中，要塞被毁。

english: In the marshy delta of the Terek, a Russian fortified settlement known as Tersky Gorod or Terki stood on the Tyumenka, one of the river's branches near the Caspian Sea. Founded in 1588, it formed part of a succession of Russian forts on the Terek and Sunzha, whose names and locations changed over time. Terki gave Russian forces a foothold in the northeastern Caucasus, but its position was contested by the peoples and rulers of the surrounding plains and foothills.
simp_chinese: 在捷列克河沼泽遍布的三角洲中，一座名为捷尔斯基戈罗德或捷尔基的俄国设防聚落坐落在靠近里海的久缅卡河汊上。它建于1588年，是俄国在捷列克河与孙扎河沿岸先后修筑的一系列堡垒之一；这些据点的名称和位置屡有变化。捷尔基为俄军在东北高加索提供了立足点，但周围平原与山麓的居民和统治者不断争夺这一地区。

english: Terekli-Mekteb lies in the Nogai steppe north of the Terek, a dry plain used by pastoral communities. It emerged as a headquarters associated with the Kara-Nogai administration created at the end of the eighteenth century and became one of the area's early settled communities. Its name combines words for trees and a school, recalling features that distinguished the place in the open steppe.
simp_chinese: 捷列克利梅克捷布位于捷列克河以北的诺盖草原，周围是牧民利用的干旱平原。十八世纪末，俄国设立卡拉诺盖行政机构，与之相关的驻地在此出现，逐渐成为当地较早的定居点之一。地名结合了“树木”和“学校”的词语，令人想起这处地方在开阔草原上的特色。

english: The Terekti country lies east of the Ural, close to the broad saline waters of Lake Shalkar. Streams descending through the steppe feed the lake's shallow basin, whose shores alternate between mud and salt-bearing ground. The surrounding grasslands formed part of the pastoral country of western Kazakhstan. In years of high water, the lake drains toward the Ural basin; in drier seasons its brackish waters remain enclosed amid the open plain.
simp_chinese: 铁列克提一带位于乌拉尔河以东，靠近宽阔的沙尔卡尔盐湖。穿过草原的溪流补给这座浅湖，湖岸遍布泥地与含盐土壤。周围草地属于哈萨克西部的牧业地区。水位较高的年份，湖水流向乌拉尔河流域；较干燥的季节，咸水则留在开阔平原的洼地中。

english: The Terena are an Arawak-speaking Indigenous people whose history connects the Chaco with the Miranda and Aquidauana river valleys. They belonged to the wider Guaná peoples, who cultivated crops and maintained alliances with the Mbayá-Guaikuru. After moving east of the Paraguay, Guaná communities established themselves in a new river country while retaining elements of their social organisation and agricultural life.
simp_chinese: 特雷纳人是使用阿拉瓦克语的原住民族，其历史将查科地区与米兰达河、阿基达瓦纳河谷联系起来。他们属于更广泛的瓜纳诸民族；瓜纳人从事耕作，并与姆巴亚－瓜伊库鲁人维持联盟。迁往巴拉圭河以东后，瓜纳社区在新的河流地区定居，同时保留了社会组织和农业生活的若干传统。

english: The hills of Terengganu rise behind the eastern coast of the Malay Peninsula. Tropical forests cover the ridges, and rivers descend through their valleys toward the South China Sea. The Dungun, Paka and Terengganu watersheds carry the monsoon rains from the uplands to the coastal plain. These wooded heights form part of the peninsula's mountainous interior, separating the eastern river basins from those farther west.
simp_chinese: 丁加奴丘陵耸立在马来半岛东岸后方。热带森林覆盖山脊，河流穿过谷地奔向南海。龙运河、北加河与丁加奴河流域将季风雨水从高地带到沿海平原。这片林木茂密的高地是半岛山地内陆的一部分，分隔东部与更西方的河流盆地。

english: The Tereshka drains the eastern slopes of the Volga Uplands before joining the Volga from the right. Its course runs through a country of wooded valleys and open land on the great river's western side. In 1621 a survey recorded Tatar nobles and Mordvin landholders using forests, hay meadows, fisheries and beaver grounds on the Tereshka and neighbouring rivers. These resources formed part of the river country later drawn into the Russian network of frontier settlements around Petrovsk and Burasy.
simp_chinese: 捷列什卡河汇集伏尔加高地东坡的水流，从右岸注入伏尔加河。它流经大河西侧林谷与开阔地交错的地区。1621年的调查记载，鞑靼贵族和莫尔多瓦土地持有人利用捷列什卡河及邻近河流沿岸的森林、草场、渔场和河狸猎场。后来，这片河谷地区被纳入彼得罗夫斯克和布拉瑟周围的俄罗斯边疆聚落网络。

english: Tereshkovichy lies south of Gomel in the countryside around the Sozh. A sixteenth-century register records the settlement among the lands contested between Lithuania and Moscow. Its inhabitants shared fishing grounds near the river with neighbouring villages, while forest beekeeping lands also figure in the records. An inventory of the Gomel estate in the 1640s lists Tereshkovichy as a small village of four households.
simp_chinese: 捷列什科维奇位于戈梅利以南、索日河周围的乡村地带。十六世纪的一份登记册将它列入立陶宛与莫斯科争夺的土地。居民与邻村共享河边渔场，记录中还提到林间养蜂地。1640年代戈梅利地产清册将捷列什科维奇记为仅有四户的小村庄。

english: Terme lies on the low Black Sea coast near the mouth of the river known in antiquity as the Thermodon. Greek writers associated the plain of Themiscyra by this river with the Amazons, the legendary women warriors who appear in stories of Heracles and the Argonauts. The river descends from the Pontic mountains into a broad coastal plain, a marked contrast to the steep shore found farther east.
simp_chinese: 泰尔梅位于黑海低平海岸，靠近古代称为忒耳摩冬的河流入海口。希腊作家将河畔忒弥斯库拉平原与传说中的女战士亚马孙人联系起来；她们出现在赫拉克勒斯和阿尔戈英雄的故事中。河流从本都山地流入宽阔海岸平原，与更东面陡峭的海岸形成鲜明对比。

sources.title: The Importance of being Aeolian. Shaping Aeolian Identities in Ancient Asia Minor.pdf

english:
Termez stands on the northern bank of the Amu Darya, the ancient Oxus, at a crossing between Transoxiana and the lands to the south. Under the Kushans it was a centre of Buddhism, and the remains of monasteries recall that early chapter of its history. In Islamic times it became a flourishing city and produced scholars including the Sufi thinker al-Hakim al-Tirmidhi, whose tomb became a place of pilgrimage.

Genghis Khan's troops destroyed Termez in 1220, but the city was rebuilt. When Ibn Battuta visited in the fourteenth century, he found it flourishing again. The local sayyids, a religious aristocracy claiming descent from the Prophet, supported Timur, and their mausoleums formed the Sultan Saodat complex. In 1404 the Castilian envoy Clavijo crossed the Amu Darya here on his journey to Timur's court at Samarkand. The Timurid age also brought new work to the shrine of al-Hakim al-Tirmidhi.
simp_chinese:
铁尔米兹坐落在阿姆河北岸，即古代的奥克苏斯河畔，是河中地区与南方之间的一处渡口。贵霜时代，这里是佛教中心，寺院遗址留存着那段历史的痕迹。伊斯兰时代，铁尔米兹发展为繁荣的城市，涌现出苏菲思想家哈基姆·提尔米济等学者；他的陵墓后来成为朝圣地。

成吉思汗的军队于1220年摧毁铁尔米兹，但城市此后得以重建。十四世纪伊本·白图泰到访时，这里已再度兴盛。当地自称先知后裔的宗教贵族赛义德家族支持帖木儿，他们的陵墓构成了苏丹萨奥达特建筑群。1404年，卡斯蒂利亚使臣克拉维霍在此渡过阿姆河，前往撒马尔罕的帖木儿宫廷。帖木儿时代，哈基姆·提尔米济的圣陵也得到增修。

english:
Termini stands above a gulf on Sicily's northern coast, on the site of ancient Thermae, named for its hot springs. Founded after the destruction of nearby Himera, the town survived into the Middle Ages and became a royal town under Norman rule. Its harbour gave the fertile interior an outlet to the Tyrrhenian Sea, while the town looked west along the coast towards Palermo.

Grain made Termini an important trading port. Records for 1407–1408 mention vessels from Lipari, Liguria, Mallorca and Catalonia among those loading grain in its roadstead. The harbour's grain-loading facilities strengthened connections with Genoa, Pisa, Venice and other Mediterranean ports. In the sixteenth century its trade reached Atlantic ports as well, carrying the produce of Sicily beyond the inland sea.
simp_chinese:
泰尔米尼坐落在西西里北岸海湾上方，古代的泰尔迈以温泉得名，曾位于此处。附近的希梅拉被毁后，新的城镇建立起来，延续至中世纪，并在诺曼统治下成为王室直属城镇。港口为肥沃腹地提供通往第勒尼安海的出口，沿岸向西则可抵达巴勒莫。

粮食使泰尔米尼成为重要商港。1407至1408年的记录提到，来自利帕里、利古里亚、马略卡和加泰罗尼亚的船只在锚地装载谷物。港口的粮食装运设施加强了与热那亚、比萨、威尼斯及其他地中海港市的联系。十六世纪，这里的贸易还抵达大西洋港口，将西西里物产运出地中海。

english:
The volcanic island of Ternate rises off the west coast of Halmahera, one of the few places where cloves originally grew. Its rulers turned the spice trade into the foundation of a powerful sultanate, drawing merchants from across Asia. Ternate's long rivalry with neighboring Tidore shaped alliances throughout the Moluccas, while its influence reached far beyond the small island itself.

The Portuguese obtained permission to build a fort in 1522, but their attempts to dominate trade and intervene in local affairs brought conflict. After Sultan Hairun was killed in 1570, his son Babullah led resistance that expelled the Portuguese from their fort in 1575. Under Babullah and his successor Said, Ternate's authority extended from parts of Sulawesi and Mindanao to eastern Seram. A Spanish expedition from Manila seized the island in 1606 and carried Sultan Said and nobles into exile; Ternate's rulers then sought Dutch support against Spain. The Company became an increasingly powerful ally, demanding control over the trade that had once sustained the sultanate's independence.

The later city of Sofifi lies here.
simp_chinese:
火山岛特尔纳特耸立在哈马黑拉西岸之外，是丁香原生的少数地方之一。岛上的统治者以香料贸易为基础建立强大的苏丹国，吸引亚洲各地的商人。特尔纳特与邻近蒂多雷的长期竞争塑造了摩鹿加各地的联盟，其影响也远远超出这座小岛。

葡萄牙人于1522年获准修筑堡垒，但他们试图控制贸易、干涉地方事务，引发了冲突。1570年海伦苏丹遇害后，其子巴布拉领导抵抗，于1575年迫使葡萄牙人退出堡垒。巴布拉及其继承者赛义德治下，特尔纳特的权威从苏拉威西和棉兰老部分地区延伸至塞兰东部。1606年，从马尼拉出发的西班牙远征军占领该岛，将赛义德苏丹及贵族带走流放；特尔纳特统治者随后寻求荷兰支持。东印度公司逐渐成为更强大的盟友，并要求控制曾经支撑苏丹国独立的贸易。

后来的索菲菲即位于此地。

english: Ternivka lies where the Velyka Ternivka River meets the Samara, east of Pavlohrad. The settlement was founded in 1775, when the governor of Azov ordered thorn thickets cleared and a sloboda established here. Its name recalls the blackthorn growing in the area. The river and its valley formed part of the network of settlements spreading through the Samara basin after the end of the Zaporozhian Sich.
simp_chinese: 泰尔尼夫卡位于巴甫洛赫拉德以东，大泰尔尼夫卡河与萨马拉河交汇之处。1775年，亚速总督下令清除这里茂密的荆棘，建立一座斯洛博达，聚落的名称令人想起当地生长的黑刺李。扎波罗热谢契终结后，这座河谷聚落成为萨马拉盆地不断扩展的定居网络的一部分。

english:
Ternopil stands on the Seret in the border country of Galicia and Podolia. Founded as Tarnopol in 1540 by the Polish commander Jan Amor Tarnowski, it began as a castle and fortified town intended to guard the eastern frontier against Tatar raids. Its name preserves that of its founder.

The town passed through the hands of the Ostrogski and Zamoyski families, and developed as an important centre of regional trade. Warfare repeatedly interrupted its growth: in 1675 Ottoman forces under Ibrahim Shishman Pasha nearly destroyed it, after which Aleksander Koniecpolski rebuilt it. Ternopil came under Austrian rule in 1772, following the first partition of Poland. It was held by Russia from 1809 to 1815, before the Congress of Vienna returned it once again to Austrian rule.
simp_chinese:
捷尔诺波尔位于加利西亚与波多利亚交界地带的谢雷特河畔。波兰指挥官扬·阿莫尔·塔尔诺夫斯基于1540年建立这座城堡和设防城镇，以保卫东部边境免受鞑靼袭击；城镇最初的名称塔尔诺波尔保留了创建者的姓氏。

这里先后归奥斯特罗格斯基和扎莫伊斯基家族所有，并发展为重要的地区贸易中心。战争屡次打断其成长：1675年，易卜拉欣·希什曼帕夏率领的奥斯曼军几乎摧毁城镇，此后亚历山大·科涅茨波尔斯基主持重建。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，捷尔诺波尔归奥地利统治。1809至1815年它一度归俄国，维也纳会议后又回到奥地利统治之下。

english: The Gulf of Patience, known in Ainu as Taraika, indents the southeastern coast of Sakhalin. The long Patience Peninsula partly shelters it from the Sea of Okhotsk, and the Poronay River enters from the north. Salmon frequent its waters, which freeze in winter. In 1643 the Dutch navigator Maarten de Vries reached the bay and gave it the name that recalls the patience required to wait out the weather.
simp_chinese: 捷尔佩尼耶湾在阿伊努语中称塔赖卡湾，深入库页岛东南岸。狭长的捷尔佩尼耶半岛将它与鄂霍次克海外海部分隔开，波罗奈河从北面注入。鲑鱼常见于湾水，冬季海湾封冻。1643年，荷兰航海家德弗里斯抵达此地；他给海湾起的名字，纪念船队耐心等待天气好转的经历。

english: Terrace Bay lies on the Namib Desert's Atlantic shore, where the land is dry but the sea is cooled by the Benguela Current. Coastal fog drifts across beaches and dunes, and rivers descending from inland usually reach the sea only after rare floods. The contrast between a barren shore and productive offshore waters is characteristic of this long stretch of southwestern Africa.
simp_chinese: 特雷斯湾位于纳米布沙漠的大西洋海岸，陆地干燥，海水却受到本格拉寒流冷却。海雾飘过沙滩与沙丘，内陆流来的河流通常只有在罕见洪水时才能抵海。荒凉海岸与富饶近海水域之间的反差，是非洲西南部这段漫长海岸的鲜明特征。

english:
Terracina stands where the Volscian Hills meet the Tyrrhenian coast, beside the Pontine Marshes. The ancient Via Appia passed this narrow point on its way south from Rome. Under Trajan, a cutting through the rock at Pisco Montano eased the road around the headland. Above the town stand the remains of the sanctuary associated with Jupiter Anxur.

The papacy brought Terracina under its authority in the ninth century, though local and Roman families later contested control. A commune developed in the Middle Ages, and the cathedral rose on the site of an ancient Roman temple. The church was consecrated in 1074. The papal constitutions of 1357 strengthened central authority, but did not end the city's internal disputes or the influence of the neighbouring Kingdom of Naples.
simp_chinese:
泰拉奇纳坐落在沃尔斯基丘陵与第勒尼安海岸相接之处，毗邻蓬廷沼泽。古代阿庇亚大道从罗马向南经过这道狭窄通道。图拉真统治时期，人们在皮斯科蒙塔诺开凿岩石，使道路更容易绕过海岬。城镇上方矗立着与安克苏尔朱庇特相关的圣所遗迹。

九世纪，教廷将泰拉奇纳置于自身统治之下，但地方和罗马家族后来争夺此地。中世纪时，城镇发展出公社，主教座堂则建在古代神庙旧址上，于1074年祝圣。1357年的教皇宪章加强了中央权威，却没有结束城内争斗，也未能消除邻近那不勒斯王国的影响。

english: Terralba lies on the Campidano plain south of Oristano in western Sardinia. It was the seat of a bishopric documented from the twelfth century, and its cathedral of Saint Peter was built in 1144 under Bishop Mariano. In 1503 the diocese was united with that of Usellus and its seat transferred to Ales. The old Romanesque cathedral was rebuilt beginning in 1821, preserving the site's long ecclesiastical association.
simp_chinese: 泰拉尔巴位于撒丁岛西部奥里斯塔诺以南的坎皮达诺平原。十二世纪的文献已记载它是主教驻地；1144年，主教马里亚诺主持建造圣彼得主教座堂。1503年，泰拉尔巴主教区与乌塞卢斯主教区合并，驻地迁至阿莱斯。古老的罗马式主教座堂从1821年起重建，这片土地的教会传统得以延续。

english: Terranova stands on a sheltered inlet on the northeastern coast of Sardinia. Known in antiquity as Olbia, it was an important Roman port and later, as Civita, a centre of the Judicate of Gallura. Its church of San Simplicio served the bishopric of Civita. By the seventeenth century the coastal town and cathedral had declined, while the inland town of Tempio gained a growing role in the religious life of Gallura.
simp_chinese: 泰拉诺瓦坐落在撒丁岛东北岸一处有遮蔽的海湾。古代此地称为奥尔比亚，是重要的罗马港口；中世纪称为奇维塔，成为加卢拉法官国的中心。圣辛普利乔教堂服务于奇维塔主教区。到十七世纪，海滨城镇和主教座堂日渐衰落，而内陆的滕皮奥在加卢拉宗教生活中的地位不断上升。

english: Terranova stands on Sicily's southern coast near the site of ancient Gela. The Greek city founded here became a powerful centre before its destruction in antiquity; its ruins lay beside the later town. Emperor Frederick II founded the new settlement in the thirteenth century, giving it walls and a castle. Known as Terranova, the town occupied a different site to the west of ancient Gela, overlooking the broad coastal plain and the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 泰拉诺瓦坐落在西西里南岸，靠近古代杰拉遗址。希腊人在此建立的城市曾是强大中心，后来在古代遭到毁灭，遗迹留在后来的城镇附近。十三世纪，皇帝腓特烈二世建立新聚落，为其修筑城墙和城堡。新城称为泰拉诺瓦，位于古杰拉以西，俯瞰宽广的海岸平原与地中海。

english:
Terrassa lies inland from Barcelona in the Valles countryside, where routes through northeastern Catalonia connect coastal markets with farming settlements and mountain districts. Its medieval community grew around a compact town and a rural hinterland, supported by agriculture, local trade, and craft production. The churches associated with the older episcopal center of Egara preserved an important religious inheritance, linking the town's later history with the Christian communities of late antiquity.

Vallparadís Castle served as a Carthusian monastery from 1344 to 1413, one of the town's surviving medieval institutions. In 1619 several women were prosecuted for witchcraft in Terrassa, and five were executed. Woollen textiles later became central to the town's development, linking its craft traditions to the industrial growth of the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
泰拉萨位于巴塞罗那内陆的瓦列斯地区，加泰罗尼亚东北部道路在这里把海岸市场、农业聚落和山地区域相连。中世纪社群围绕紧凑城镇及农村腹地发展，依靠耕作、地方贸易与手工业维持生活。与古老埃加拉主教中心有关的教堂保存了重要宗教遗产，使城镇后来的历史与古代晚期基督教社群之间保持可见联系，也赋予地方生活独特的历史深度。

瓦尔帕拉迪斯城堡在1344至1413年间作为加尔都西会修道院使用，是城镇保存的中世纪遗产之一。1619年，数名女性在泰拉萨遭到巫术指控，其中五人被处死。毛纺织业后来成为城市发展的核心，将手工传统与十九世纪工业增长联系起来。

english: Terrest lies on the middle course of the Moulouya, near Tissaf and Outat El Haj, where the river crosses the dry plains below the eastern Middle Atlas. Rising where the Middle and High Atlas meet, the Moulouya runs more than 500 km to the Mediterranean, and the villages along its banks farmed in otherwise stony country. Before they founded their dynasty, the Zenata Banu Marin moved their herds each year between the Figuig oasis and the Moulouya basin; in the 1240s they rode north from these grazing lands to take Taza and Fez.
simp_chinese: 泰雷斯特位于穆卢耶河中游，靠近蒂萨夫和乌塔特哈杰，河流在此穿过中阿特拉斯山东麓下的干旱平原。穆卢耶河发源于中阿特拉斯与高阿特拉斯交会处，流经五百多公里注入地中海，沿岸村落在这片多石的土地上耕作。马林王朝立国以前，扎纳塔部落的马林人每年在菲吉格绿洲与穆卢耶河流域之间迁徙放牧；13世纪40年代，他们便是从这片牧地北上，夺取了塔扎和非斯。

english: Teruel rises on a high plateau near the meeting of the Guadalaviar and Alfambra. Founded under Alfonso II in 1171, it developed as a frontier town where Christian, Muslim and Jewish communities contributed to urban life. Its brick towers and the painted wooden ceiling of Santa María are among the finest expressions of Aragonese Mudéjar art. In 1347 Peter IV granted Teruel the title of city in recognition of its loyalty during the conflict with the Union of Aragon. The distinction brought privileges, later withdrawn and restored in 1366. Its churches and towers bear witness to the skills of craftsmen who worked across cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 特鲁埃尔耸立在瓜达拉维亚尔河与阿尔凡夫拉河汇合处附近的高台上。它于1171年在阿方索二世统治下建立，发展为边境城镇，基督徒、穆斯林和犹太社群都参与了城市生活。砖砌塔楼和圣玛丽亚教堂绘饰的木天花板，是阿拉贡穆德哈尔艺术的杰出作品。1347年，佩德罗四世为表彰特鲁埃尔在与阿拉贡联盟冲突中的忠诚，授予它城市称号。称号附带的特权后来被收回，又于1366年恢复。城中的教堂和塔楼见证了跨越不同文化传统的工匠技艺。

english: Tervenichi lies in the lake and forest country south of the Svir, among the old rural districts of Novgorod. It is named as a tribute-collecting place in a thirteenth-century addition to Prince Svyatoslav Olgovich’s charter. A later list of the upland Obonezhskaya church districts includes the church of St Michael at Tervenichi. The pogost was a centre for villages spread through the wooded hinterland between the Pasha and the Svir.
simp_chinese: 捷尔韦尼奇位于斯维里河以南的森林湖泊地带，是诺夫哥罗德古老的乡村辖区之一。十三世纪对斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇亲王敕书的补记将它列为收贡地点。后来的奥博涅日高地教堂辖区清单中，又有捷尔韦尼奇的圣米迦勒教堂。这个教堂村是帕沙河与斯维里河之间森林腹地众多村落的中心。

english: Tes lies along the river that supplies much of the water of Uvs Nuur. Rising in the mountains to the east, the Tes flows west through the steppe and into the great salt lake, spreading into wetlands near its mouth. The river belongs to an enclosed basin with no outlet to the sea, where desert, grassland and mountain habitats lie within a comparatively small area.
simp_chinese: 特斯位于同名河流沿岸，这条河为乌布苏湖提供了大部分来水。特斯河发源于东方山地，向西穿过草原注入大盐湖，并在入湖口附近形成湿地。河流属于没有出海口的内流盆地；荒漠、草原和山地生境在这一相对有限的区域中并存。

english: Tescuntee lies near the Etowah River and its great earthen mounds. A Mississippian town occupied the north bank near Cartersville, with a plaza, village and several mounds. The largest mound was enlarged into a high platform during the settlement's flourishing after 1250. A fortified wall was built in the fourteenth century, but the town declined after 1375 and was abandoned by about 1550.
simp_chinese: 特斯坎蒂靠近埃托瓦河及其巨大的土丘。密西西比文化时期的一座城镇坐落在河流北岸、卡特斯维尔附近，拥有广场、村落与数座土丘。1250年后聚落繁荣，最大的土丘被扩建为高台。十四世纪当地修筑了防御墙，但城镇在1375年后衰落，约1550年时已被废弃。

english: Tesechoacán stands beside the river of the same name in the warm Papaloapan basin. The river descends from the mountains of Oaxaca, winds across the Gulf coastal plain and joins the Papaloapan near Tlacotalpan. Around 1600 the town was described as a community subject to Guaspaltepec, with fields of cotton and cacao near the forest. Its inhabitants spoke Nahuatl, and the river ran beside their settlement.
simp_chinese: 特塞乔阿坎坐落在温暖的帕帕洛阿潘盆地，位于同名河流旁。河流从瓦哈卡群山流下，蜿蜒穿过墨西哥湾海岸平原，在特拉科塔尔潘附近汇入帕帕洛阿潘河。约1600年的记载称，该镇隶属瓜斯帕尔特佩克，森林附近有棉花和可可田。居民说纳瓦特尔语，河流从聚落旁经过。

english: Tesenei lies beside the Gash River in the western lowlands, where the river descends from the Eritrean highlands toward the Sudanese plain. Known upstream as the Mereb, the Gash flows seasonally and spreads into branching channels across the open country. Its waters and sandy bed stand out in a dry landscape, linking the highland rains to the broad lowland plain around the settlement.
simp_chinese: 泰塞内坐落在西部低地的加什河畔。河水从厄立特里亚高地流向苏丹平原，上游称为默勒布河。加什河随季节涨落，进入开阔低地后分成多条河道。河水与宽阔沙质河床在干旱景观中格外醒目，将高地降雨带到聚落周围的低地平原。

english: Teshevka grew beside the stream of the same name near its meeting with the Don. A monastic settlement was recorded here in 1615, and a wooden church near the river mouth became the beginning of the Zadonsk Monastery. Its peasants formed the settlement of Teshevka amid land granted to support the religious house. In 1764 the village passed out of monastic ownership, and in 1779 it became the district town of Zadonsk. Its earlier name remained attached to the stream that divided the town.
simp_chinese: 捷舍夫卡兴起于同名溪流靠近顿河汇合处的地方。1615年的文书记载了这里的修道院聚落，河口附近的一座木教堂成为扎东斯克修道院的起点。修道院的农民在赐给宗教机构的土地上形成了捷舍夫卡聚落。1764年，村庄脱离修道院的所有权；1779年，它成为县城扎东斯克。原来的名字则留在了穿过城镇的溪流上。

english: Teshio lies at the mouth of a great river flowing into the Sea of Japan. Ainu communities along its lower course fished for salmon and trout, hunted in the surrounding country and exchanged marine goods for products from the upper river. Their contacts also reached Sakhalin and other coastal communities. A Matsumae trading district was established at the river mouth in 1786; eleven years later a survey party ascended the river as far as Otoineppu.
simp_chinese: 天盐位于一条注入日本海的大河河口。下游的阿伊努社区捕捞鲑鱼和鳟鱼，在周围地区狩猎，并以海产换取上游的山中物产；他们的往来还延伸至桦太和其他沿海社区。1786年，松前藩在河口设立交易场所。十一年后，一支调查队溯河而上，抵达音威子府。

english:
Těšín, known in Polish as Cieszyn and in German as Teschen, stands on the Olza at the foot of the Beskids. From 1290 it was the capital of a Silesian duchy ruled by a branch of the Piast dynasty. Its castle overlooked a town in which Polish, Czech and German traditions met along the approaches between Silesia and the Carpathians.

The Piast line ruled Cieszyn until 1653, when the duchy passed to the Habsburgs. Unlike much of Silesia, it remained Austrian after the wars of Frederick II of Prussia. In May 1779 the town lent its name to the Peace of Teschen, concluded between Austria and Prussia to end the War of the Bavarian Succession. The agreement made this ducal town the setting for a settlement of a dispute reaching far beyond Silesia.
simp_chinese:
捷欣位于贝斯基德山麓的奥尔扎河畔，波兰语称切申，德语称特申。自1290年起，它是皮雅斯特家族一个支系统治的西里西亚公国首府。城堡俯瞰着城镇；在西里西亚与喀尔巴阡山之间的道路上，波兰、捷克与德意志传统在此交会。

皮雅斯特家族在采申的统治持续至1653年，随后公国转归哈布斯堡家族。普鲁士国王腓特烈二世发动战争后，西里西亚大部分地区易手，采申却仍属奥地利。1779年5月，奥地利与普鲁士在此缔结《特申和约》，结束巴伐利亚王位继承战争。这座公国首府因此成为解决一场远超西里西亚范围的争端的场所。

english: Tesinigh lay on the Susquehanna below the mouth of the Conestoga Creek, in the country of the Susquehannock and their neighbours in south-central Pennsylvania. The river here runs wide and shallow between low hills, with rich bottomland that supported corn fields and village sites for generations. The Susquehannock traded furs and deerskins down the river to the Chesapeake, and their towns were the western partners of the Virginia and Maryland colonists. After the Susquehannock were defeated in the wars of 1675 and 1676, survivors left the lower river, and English traders and settlers gradually took up the land along its banks.
simp_chinese: 特西尼位于萨斯奎哈纳河上，在科内斯托加溪河口下方，地处宾夕法尼亚中南部萨斯奎汉诺克人及其邻族的居地。河水在这里沿低丘间宽浅地流过，河滩土地肥沃，世代承载着玉米田和村落。萨斯奎汉诺克人沿河把毛皮和鹿皮运往切萨皮克湾，他们的村镇也是弗吉尼亚和马里兰殖民者在西面的贸易伙伴。1675和1676年的战争中萨斯奎汉诺克人战败，幸存者离开下游河段，英国商人和移民此后逐渐占据河岸土地。

english: Between the Stikine River and Teslin Lake, trails cross a country of mountains, rivers and wetlands. They belong to an older network of travel and exchange among the peoples of the northern interior. Tahltan traders travelled from the Stikine towards Dease Lake, where they met Kaska trading partners; another route followed the Dease River towards the upper Liard. These journeys connected communities across the high country between the Pacific watershed and the northern rivers.
simp_chinese: 斯蒂金河与特斯林湖之间，道路穿过山岭、河流和湿地，属于北方内陆各族往来与交换的古老网络。塔尔坦商人从斯蒂金河前往迪斯湖，在那里与卡斯卡贸易伙伴相会；另一条道路沿迪斯河通向利亚德河上游。这些行程将太平洋流域与北方河流之间高地上的各个社群联系起来。

english: Teso lies in the plains east of Lake Kyoga, home to the Iteso, an Eastern Nilotic-speaking people related to the Karimojong. Cattle have long been a source of wealth and a part of marriage exchanges. Over several centuries groups moved south and west from the drier Karamoja country into the better-watered lands of Teso. Cultivation grew in importance alongside herding as communities settled in their new surroundings, though cattle remained valued in their social life.
simp_chinese: 特索位于基奥加湖以东的平原，是伊特索人的家园。他们使用东尼罗语支语言，与卡拉莫琼人有亲缘联系。牛群长期是财富的来源，也是婚姻交换的一部分。几个世纪里，各群体从较干燥的卡拉莫琼地区向南、向西迁入水源更充足的特索。随着社群在新环境中定居，耕作与放牧相比日益重要，但牛在社会生活中仍受到珍视。

sources.title: EDUCATION IN EASTERN UGANDA, 1900-1939; A STUDY OF INITIATIVE AND RESPONSE DURING THE EARLY COLONIAL PERIOD.pdf

english: Tesov was a small fortified place in the Novgorod lands, known from chronicles of the thirteenth century. German forces took it during their advance in 1240, an event the chronicler treated as a serious blow to Novgorod. The Tesov district appears again in records of 1400–1401, and the Klementovsky Tesov pogost was listed in the Vodskaya land register of 1500. In 1648 the Tesov district was transferred to the cathedral of Saint Sophia in Novgorod in an exchange of lands with the state.
simp_chinese: 捷索夫是诺夫哥罗德领地中的一处小型设防地点，十三世纪的编年史已有记载。1240年，德意志军队进攻时夺取了这里，编年史作者将其视为对诺夫哥罗德的一次重大打击。捷索夫地区再次见于1400至1401年的记载；1500年的沃德斯卡亚土地登记簿列有克列缅托夫斯基捷索夫波戈斯特。1648年，在与国家交换土地时，捷索夫辖区被转交诺夫哥罗德的圣索菲亚主教座堂。

english: The Tessala hills rise between the plains of western Algeria, south of Oran. Their name was applied to a wider country between Tlemcen and Mascara as well as to the mountain chain itself. Ibn Khaldun described the Beni Amer as occupying land extending from Tessala and Mleta towards the heights above Oran. The ridges offered shelter to their inhabitants in troubled times, while the neighbouring plains formed part of the inhabited country of the western Maghreb.
simp_chinese: 塔萨拉丘陵位于阿尔及利亚西部平原之间，在奥兰以南。这个名字既指山脉，也曾用于特莱姆森与穆阿斯凯尔之间更广阔的地区。伊本·赫勒敦记述，贝尼阿梅尔人占据的土地从塔萨拉和姆莱塔延伸至奥兰上方的高地。局势动荡时，山岭为居民提供庇护；周围平原则是西马格里布有人居住的地区之一。

english: Tessaoua lies northeast of Katsina in the Hausa country of the southern Sahel. Local traditions connect its foundation with the Tazarawa, who are said to have lived first at Birnin Tazar before settling here. Their arrival in the Katsina region is placed by tradition in the sixteenth century. In the early nineteenth century, the wars that followed the Sokoto jihad changed the political balance across Hausaland. After Fulani forces were driven from Maradi and neighbouring northern districts in 1819, Tessaoua became part of the state centred on Maradi.
simp_chinese: 泰萨瓦位于卡齐纳东北方，处在萨赫勒南部的豪萨地区。地方传统将它的建立与塔扎拉瓦人联系起来，传说这一族群先居住在比尔尼塔扎尔，随后才迁居此地。按照传统，他们在十六世纪来到卡齐纳地区。十九世纪初，索科托圣战引发的战争改变了豪萨兰的政治格局。1819年富拉尼军队被逐出马拉迪及附近北方地区后，泰萨瓦成为以马拉迪为中心的国家的一部分。

english: Tessit lies south of the Niger near a seasonal pond in the Sahelian country around Ansongo. In this dry landscape, rain-fed waters and pasture support herds as well as settlements. The Niger flows to the north and east, providing fish and cultivated floodplain land amid the surrounding plains. Communities in the region combine farming, fishing and livestock keeping, adjusting their movements to the changing availability of water through the year.
simp_chinese: 泰西特位于尼日尔河以南，靠近安松戈周边萨赫勒地区的一处季节性水塘。在这片干燥土地上，雨水补给的水域与牧场支撑着牲畜和聚落。尼日尔河从北面和东面流过，在平原间提供渔获及可耕种的洪泛地。当地社群结合农业、捕鱼和畜牧，根据一年中水源的变化调整行动。

sources.title: Mali - Ansongo District Rural Development Project - Appraisal Report.pdf

english: Tessuialluk is a lake near the indented coast of Labrador, west of the waters around Jeanette Bay. The surrounding country lies along a shore where Inuit place names recorded landmarks, hunting places and routes. By the eighteenth century, Inuit travelled between northern and southern Labrador and traded with European visitors; sealskins, oil and baleen were among the goods that passed through these coastal exchanges. The lake belongs to a landscape of bays, islands and inland waters known by generations of travellers.
simp_chinese: 特苏亚卢克是一座靠近拉布拉多曲折海岸的湖泊，位于珍妮特湾水域以西。周围海岸的因纽特地名记录着地标、猎场和行旅路线。到了十八世纪，因纽特人往返于拉布拉多南北之间，并与欧洲来客交易；海豹皮、油和鲸须都是沿岸交换的货物。这座湖泊与海湾、岛屿和内陆水域一起，构成了世代旅人熟悉的土地。

english: Tetamekanch lies near Neshaminy Creek, which flows southeast into the Delaware River. Lenape communities lived in this river country before William Penn's colony grew along the Delaware. In 1682 Penn made his first land purchase from Lenape leaders; a second purchase the following year extended north to Neshaminy Creek. A ferry operated across the Delaware from 1679, carrying travellers between the opposite banks.
simp_chinese: 泰塔梅坎奇靠近内沙米尼溪；溪水向东南注入特拉华河。威廉·宾的殖民地沿河扩展之前，莱纳佩社群已生活于此。1682年，宾首次向莱纳佩首领购地；次年的第二笔购地北达内沙米尼溪。自1679年起，一处渡船横越特拉华河，运送往来两岸的旅人。

english: Tete stands on the Zambezi River in the southeastern African interior. Portuguese traders settled here during the sixteenth century, attracted by routes to the gold-producing lands of the Monomotapa. In the seventeenth century goods moved upriver from Sena to Tete and onward to inland trading fairs. Merchants at Tete also developed connections with Undi's kingdom and the wider Maravi world. These exchanges depended on African rulers, traders and carriers as well as the river and overland routes. From around 1590 lands in the surrounding region were granted to Portuguese subjects under arrangements later known as prazos; the estates became influential centres of power in the Zambezi valley. In 1767 the Portuguese governor moved the seat of the Rivers of Sena administration to Tete amid military pressure from Karanga groups on the estates and the caravans to Zumbo. Its history reflects a meeting of African inland networks and Portuguese commercial ambitions, shaped by negotiation and conflict.
simp_chinese: 太特位于非洲东南部内陆的赞比西河畔。十六世纪，葡萄牙商人受通往莫诺莫塔帕产金地区的道路吸引，在此定居。十七世纪，货物从塞纳沿河运至太特，再转往内陆贸易集市；太特商人也与温迪王国及更广阔的马拉维地区建立联系。这些交换依靠非洲统治者、商人和运输者，也依靠河道及陆路。约1590年起，周边土地以后来称为普拉佐的方式授予葡萄牙臣民，庄园逐渐成为赞比西河谷的重要权力中心。1767年，葡萄牙总督面对卡兰加人对庄园及通往宗博商队的军事压力，将塞纳诸河地区的行政驻地迁至太特。当地历史体现了非洲内陆网络与葡萄牙商业活动的交汇，其中既有协商，也有冲突。

sources.title: Vol 5. Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century editor B.A.OGOT(FILEminimizer).pdf

english: Tetela lies among the ridges and valleys of the Sierra Norte de Puebla. The mountains separate the high Mexican plateau from the humid lands descending toward the Gulf of Mexico. Nahua and other Indigenous communities inhabited the region before the Spanish conquest, maintaining settlements along its steep slopes and valleys. In 1519 the expedition of Hernán Cortés crossed the northern Puebla highlands through neighbouring Ixtacamaxtitlán on its way inland.
simp_chinese: 特特拉位于普埃布拉北部山脉的山岭与谷地之间。群山将墨西哥高原与通向墨西哥湾的湿润地带隔开。西班牙征服前，纳瓦人及其他原住民社群居住在这一地区，聚落分布于陡坡和谷地。1519年，埃尔南·科尔特斯的远征队穿越普埃布拉北部高地，经邻近的伊斯塔卡马克斯蒂特兰向内陆前行。

english: Tetela Boa lies near Tshumbe, in the country between the Sankuru and Lomami rivers. This is part of the wider homeland of Tetela communities. Their musical traditions include the six-toned lukumbi slit drum, used both for communication and in a developed poetic and musical art.
simp_chinese: 泰泰拉博阿靠近琼贝，位于桑库鲁河与洛马米河之间。这一带属于泰泰拉诸社群的广大故地。他们的音乐传统包括六音卢昆比缝鼓，既用于传递讯息，也用于诗歌和音乐表演。

english: Tetellan lay in the southern Mexican interior of the Balsas basin, where valleys and hills rise from the warm river lands toward the central highlands. The changing elevation supported different crops, and villages traded maize, chilli and cotton across the slopes. Cuitlatec and Nahua speakers lived in the region, and their settlements paid tribute to Tepecoacuilco, whose lords controlled the valleys. Trails connected the hills with the riverside markets, carrying salt, cloth and feathers between the highlands and the Pacific lowlands.
simp_chinese: 特泰兰位于墨西哥南部内陆的巴尔萨斯盆地，河谷与山丘从温暖的河岸地带向中部高地抬升。海拔的变化使不同作物得以生长，村落之间沿斜坡交换玉米、辣椒和棉花。这一带住着讲奎特拉特克语和纳瓦特尔语的人群，他们的聚落向统辖河谷的特佩科阿奎尔科领主纳贡。小路把山丘与河畔市场相连，把盐、布匹和羽毛运往高地与太平洋低地之间。

english: Tetepisca is a long lake among the wooded uplands north of the St. Lawrence, draining south toward the Outardes River. On its shores is a rock-art site known to the Innu as Memekueshushuap, “the house of the Memekueshuat.” These beings belong to stories of the Innu country, and their name gives the painted rock a place in that tradition. Families have camped beside the lake while hunting and gathering food in the surrounding territory.
simp_chinese: 特特皮斯卡湖狭长，位于圣劳伦斯河以北的林木高地，湖水向南流往乌塔尔德河。湖岸有一处岩画遗址，因努人称之为梅梅奎舒舒阿普，即“梅梅奎舒阿特的家”。这些存在见于因努人的故事，名字将岩画与当地传说联系起来。因努家庭曾在湖边扎营，在周围地域狩猎和获取食物。

english: North of Lake Athabasca, the Tethul River drains a country of flat ground and many small lakes. Its Dene name belongs to a waterway that joins the Taltson River on its journey toward Great Slave Lake. The basin lies near the edge of the Canadian Shield, where thin glacial deposits cover ancient rock. Lakes and channels break up the northern forest, providing a landscape of connected waters rather than a single open plain.
simp_chinese: 阿萨巴斯卡湖以北，特图尔河流经平坦而湖泊众多的土地。河名来自德内语，这条水道汇入塔尔特森河，再流向大奴湖。流域靠近加拿大地盾边缘，古老岩石上覆盖着薄薄的冰川沉积物。湖泊与水道分割北方森林，形成一片彼此相连的水域，而非单一开阔平原。

english: Tetiʻaroa is a coral atoll north of Tahiti, with low islets surrounding a lagoon. Its shores belonged to a network of canoe routes connecting the Society Islands. Tahitian chiefs visited the atoll, whose sheltered lagoon and coconut-covered islets lay a voyage away from the high volcanic island to the south.
simp_chinese: 泰蒂亚罗阿是塔希提以北的珊瑚环礁，低矮小岛环绕潟湖。它的海岸属于连接社会群岛的独木舟航路网络。塔希提首领曾到访此地，受庇护的潟湖和长着椰树的小岛与南方高耸火山岛之间隔着一段航程。

english: Tetiaroa is a coral atoll north of Tahiti, with low islets surrounding a lagoon. Tahitians knew and visited the atoll before European contact. Samuel Wallis recorded Tetiaroa during his 1767 voyage through the Society Islands, whose inhabited shores were already connected by Polynesian voyaging.
simp_chinese: 特蒂阿罗阿是塔希提以北的一座珊瑚环礁，低矮小岛环绕潟湖。与欧洲人接触之前，塔希提人已认识并到访这座环礁。塞缪尔·沃利斯于1767年航经社会群岛时记载了特蒂阿罗阿；群岛上有人居住的海岸早已通过波利尼西亚航行相连。

english: Tetioneshohon lies in the country north of Lake Ontario, near the upper Humber River. The Toronto Carrying Place connected the lake with the Holland River and Lake Simcoe, following the Humber valley for much of its course. Indigenous peoples used this route for trade and travel; Étienne Brûlé travelled it in 1615.
simp_chinese: 特蒂奥内肖洪位于安大略湖北方，靠近亨伯河上游。多伦多搬运道连接安大略湖、霍兰河与锡姆科湖，大部分路程沿亨伯河谷延伸。原住民利用这条路线贸易和旅行；1615年，艾蒂安·布吕莱也曾经过这里。

english: Teełay, or Tetlin, lies along the Tetlin River near the headwaters of the Tanana. The Upper Tanana name refers to a stream flowing down, and the surrounding country includes lakes, river channels and the routes of migratory birds. Tetlin and neighbouring Last Tetlin were associated with an Upper Tanana group whose families travelled between hunting and fishing camps as the seasons changed. The lakes and waterways of the upper Tanana formed part of a homeland that reached toward the mountains and the country to the east.
simp_chinese: 特莱，即特特林，位于特特林河畔，靠近塔纳纳河源头。这个上塔纳纳语名称指向向下流淌的溪流，周围地区有湖泊、河道和候鸟迁徙的路线。特特林及邻近的拉斯特特特林与一个上塔纳纳族群相联系，其家庭随季节在狩猎和捕鱼营地之间迁行。塔纳纳河上游的湖泊与水道是他们家园的一部分，家园还延伸向山地和东部土地。

english:
Tetovo stands beneath the Šar Mountains on the edge of the Polog plain, where the Pena River emerges from the highlands. Under Ottoman rule the town acquired religious and charitable buildings that made it an important local center. Among them was a mosque endowed by two local sisters, Hurshida and Mensure, whose tomb stands in its courtyard.

In 1799 Recep Pasha endowed the grounds of the Arabati Baba tekke, a religious complex associated with the Bektashi dervishes. Its buildings provided spaces for worship, hospitality and daily life. His son Abdurrahman Pasha later rebuilt the sisters' mosque in 1833, commissioning skilled craftsmen to decorate it with vivid painted designs. The resulting Painted Mosque became one of Tetovo's most distinctive buildings beside the river.
simp_chinese:
泰托沃位于波洛格平原边缘，沙尔山脉耸立在上方，佩纳河从高地流出。奥斯曼统治时期，城镇兴建宗教和慈善建筑，成为重要的地方中心。其中一座清真寺由当地的胡尔希达与门苏雷姐妹捐建，她们的陵墓位于寺院庭院中。

1799年，雷杰普帕夏为阿拉巴蒂巴巴修道院的院落设立基金。这座与贝克塔什派德尔维希有关的建筑群，为礼拜、接待客人和日常生活提供场所。他的儿子阿卜杜拉赫曼帕夏后来于1833年重建姐妹捐建的清真寺，委托工匠绘制鲜艳的装饰。由此形成的彩绘清真寺成为泰托沃河畔最独特的建筑之一。

english: Tetrino stands on the Tersky coast of the White Sea. In 1660 inhabitants of Varzuga moved to the coast and established a village here, among the fishing stations near river mouths. The salmon fishery drew Pomor households to the shore, where seasonal stations supplied both local communities and distant owners of fishing rights. In 1785 Tetrino had five households, a small settlement in a chain of villages along the coast.
simp_chinese: 捷特里诺位于白海的捷尔斯基海岸。1660年，瓦尔祖加的一些居民迁往海边，在河口附近渔站之间建立了村庄。鲑鱼渔业吸引波莫尔家庭来到海岸；季节性渔场既服务当地社群，也为远方拥有捕鱼权的人提供产物。1785年，捷特里诺有五户人家，是沿岸村庄链中的一处小聚落。

english:
Tetyushi stands on the high right bank of the Volga, overlooking the river south of Kazan. Known in the time of the Kazan Khanate, it became a Russian frontier fortress in the sixteenth century. Its garrison and nearby line of forest defences guarded the middle Volga as Russian authority expanded into the region.

The date of the fortress is disputed, but it was established in the second half of the sixteenth century. Streltsy and other service people formed its garrison. After Simbirsk and a new fortified line were built farther south in the mid-seventeenth century, Tetyushi's military role diminished; some of its Cossacks were transferred to the new frontier. The town remained a local centre on the Volga, receiving district-town status under Catherine II's administrative reforms.
simp_chinese:
捷秋希坐落在伏尔加河高耸的右岸，俯瞰喀山以南的河段。这里在喀山汗国时代已为人所知，16世纪成为俄罗斯边境堡垒。随着俄罗斯权力在当地扩展，驻军与附近的林障防线守护着中伏尔加地区。

堡垒的确切建造日期有争议，但它建立于16世纪后半叶。射击军和其他服役人员组成驻军。17世纪中叶，辛比尔斯克及更南方的新防线建成后，捷秋希的军事作用减弱，部分哥萨克被迁往新边境。城镇仍是伏尔加河畔的地方中心，在叶卡捷琳娜二世的行政改革中获得县城地位。

english: Tetzapotitlan is associated by researchers with the archaeological site of Castillo de Teayo in the southern Huasteca, in northern Veracruz. Its sculptures and pyramidal remains reflect a community at the meeting of Gulf Coast and central Mexican traditions. In the later fifteenth century, the expansion of the Triple Alliance brought warfare and subjection to communities in this region. Archaeological and historical research connects Tetzapotitlan with these campaigns and with the circulation of religious and political imagery. Its history illustrates the interaction of local Huastec societies and powerful highland states before Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 研究者将特察波蒂特兰与瓦斯特卡南部、韦拉克鲁斯北部的特阿约城堡考古遗址联系起来。这里的雕塑与金字塔基址，反映出墨西哥湾沿岸与墨西哥中部传统交汇的社群。十五世纪后期，三方联盟的扩张给这一地区的社群带来战争与征服。考古和历史研究将特察波蒂特兰与这些军事行动，以及宗教和政治图像的传播联系起来。它的历史体现了西班牙征服以前，地方瓦斯特卡社会与高地强国之间的互动。

english:
Tetzcoco was the capital of the Acolhua on the eastern shore of the lake that bears its name. Together with Tenochtitlan and Tlacopan, it formed the Triple Alliance that ruled much of central Mexico. Its celebrated ruler Nezahualcoyotl was remembered for poetry as well as government, and the city’s palaces and gardens reflected the wealth and prestige of its ruling house.

In 1428 Nezahualcoyotl joined the Mexica in defeating the Tepanec power of Azcapotzalco. Tetzcoco emerged as one of the principal partners in the new alliance. A succession dispute after the death of Nezahualpilli later divided the royal family. When Cortés arrived, Ixtlilxochitl allied himself with the Spaniards against Tenochtitlan. In 1521 Tetzcoco became their base, and brigantines were assembled there for the assault on the island capital. The city remained an important Indigenous centre under Spanish rule.

The later city of Ciudad Nezahualcóyotl lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
特斯科科是阿科尔瓦人的都城，位于同名湖的东岸。它与特诺奇蒂特兰、特拉科潘组成三国同盟，统治墨西哥中部广大地区。著名的统治者内萨瓦尔科约特尔不仅以治国闻名，也因诗歌为后世所铭记；城中的宫殿与花园体现了王室的财富和声望。

1428年，内萨瓦尔科约特尔联合墨西加人击败阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克势力。特斯科科随后成为新同盟的主要成员之一。内萨瓦尔皮利死后，继承之争使王室分裂。科尔特斯抵达时，伊斯特利尔绍奇特尔与西班牙人结盟，对抗特诺奇蒂特兰。1521年，特斯科科成为他们的基地，进攻湖中都城所用的双桅船在此组装。西班牙统治下，特斯科科仍是重要的原住民中心。

后来的内萨瓦尔科约特尔城位于此地附近。

english: Cape Teulada is the southernmost point of Sardinia, projecting into the Mediterranean towards the African coast. The limestone headland is joined to the island by a narrow sandy isthmus, with Cala Piombo to the west and Porto Zafferano to the east.
